notes.title: [COMPLETE]9/19 Temporary Maintenance
notes.content:
[h3][9/19 Addendum][/h3]
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The maintenance begun on 13:00 am (PDT) 9/19, 2025 has
concluded as of 3:00 am 9/19, 2025 (PDT).

[h2]Update Information[/h2]
・In the Kaga field, partner characters was able to be brought out.


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
・Changed so that partner characters cannot be summoned in the Kaga field.

・Fixed an issue where players who were in the [Summer Festival Grounds] field prior to the maintenance on 2025/9/18, would still enter the [Summer Festival Grounds] upon logging in, even though the event had ended.


----------------------------------------------------------------

As compensation for the Temporary maintenance, we will be sending the following items.

[b]■Compensation Items[/b]
・Full Energy Restorative x4

[b]◆Validity[/b]
　Accounts existing as of 13:00 am PDT, 9/19, 2025

※Items will be delivered to an account's present box.
　Gifts can be received by navigating to the [Menu] → [System] → [Present] screens.
※Item can only be recieved by one character per account, so please select the correct character.
※Compensation items will not be destributed on a specific schedule.


Thank you for your attention.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
Thank you for supporting Onigiri!

[hr][/hr]

Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

We will be conducting temporary maintenance on September 19th at 13:00 am PDT.
This maintenance is expected to finish at [b]3:00 am PDT on September 19th[/b].

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3eb9f86846cda8395ccd0cb179c9d6d650c16eef.jpg[/img]

[b]～Story～[/b]
Maeda Toshiie comes to the heroes on Onigashima to report a strange incident that occurred in his homeland, [Ogoya Mines].
What exactly has happened in Kaga, where humans and yokai coexist?

During the event period, the NPC [Maeda Toshiie]will appear in front of the Statue on Onigashima.
By speaking with him, you can progress through the event quests.

[b]※To accept this event quest, you must have cleared the main quest [Rescuing Lady Shizuka and Yoshitsune].[/b]

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆Event Items & Event Bonuses◆[/b]
By clearing each event dungeon, you can obtain event items.
Additionally, if certain conditions are met, you can obtain more event items upon completion.

■List of characters and items with bonuses
[Partner Characters]

[Accessories]
　Kayjee, Tosheeay, Inucho, Inucho - Broken Seal

※Select the Bonus button on the dungeon panel to confirm bonus details.
※Please be sure to use Summoning Scrolls prior to entering a Dungeon in order to be eligible for the Bonus.
※Please clear the dungeon with the target accessories equipped.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆Event Rewards◆[/b]
By clearing the event quests, the Exchange Shop will be unlocked with the NPC [Maeda Keiji].

notes.title: Onigiri Questionnaire 2025 Results!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/7c146878f9f24501321990b1eeee86e3acc14a42.jpg[/img]

[Addendum 9/16]
-Typos have been corrected.


Greetings from the Onigiri Management Team.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!
We appreciate all of your responses to the 2025 Onigiri Questionnaire.

We will share select results from the questionnaire with you all below.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Questions about Events[/h2]

[h3]Q.Which events would you like to see return? (Choose up to 3) [/h3]
※Some events have been excluded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/946553b83449f71ab54854e8511a401c4ea8e4d5.png[/img]
1st：Burning Shinobi and the Cursed Town
2nd：None in particular
3rd：Onigashima Summer Festival Quest 2016 (Bug Catching)
4th：Akitsu, Kusatsu, and the Peerless
5th：The Frigid Wolf
6th：The Beast of the New Year
7th：Onigashima Summer Festival
8th：Valentine 2019 event

[hr][/hr][h2]Questions about Dungeons [/h2]

[h3]Q.Which dungeon do you find the most fun to fight in? (Choose up to 2)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e721b99248b04e8aa55b32411354a4cd12da9185.png[/img]
1st：None in particular
2nd：Storage Warehouse Secret Corridor
3rd：Assault! Dullahan -Puragtorium-
4th：Rainbow Cove
5th：Forest of Chaos Delirium
6th：Amatsumihira Miasmic Skies
7th：Assault! Cursect Princess -Puragtorium-
8th：Isolated Research Facility Control Tower


[hr][/hr][h2]Questions about Updates[/h2]

[h3]Q.What variety of updates would you like to see in the future? (Choose up to 2)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/63a40fccd26011d9cfee64ef4554485064811c30.png[/img]
1st：Main Story Update
2nd：Upgraded to existing characters
3rd：Quality of Life upgrades (UI, etc)
4th：New events added
5th：Purgatorium Dungeons added


[hr][/hr][h2]Questions about Partner Characters[/h2]
※Some characters have been excluded.

[h3]Q.Which Vanguard/Divine Possession character do you think has the best abilites. (Choose up to 5)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/119ab6d61282eb11886901177f3bae89c4a6977e.png[/img]

2nd：Kirigakure Saizo

10th：Venus


[h3]Q.Which Battle Mount's abilities do you like the most? (Choose up to 2)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/37b340da9ce22ebb1ed512aa8ba7c38552036853.png[/img]
1st：Ooguchi Makami
2nd：None in particular
3rd： Leviathan
4th：Ifrit


[h3]Q.Which support characters do you think has the best support abilities? (Choose up to 2)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e8465b569316f2d24fbde23d0eaa054ea78f6bf0.png[/img]
1st：Lucifer
2nd：None in particular
3rd：Tohoku Kiritan
4th：Satan
5th：Lady Daruma


[h3]Q.Which characters' design do you like the best? (Choose up to 5)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4a9a119ea53effa4ea2b6dcb7ebcf116079225c5.png[/img]

2nd：Yagyu Jubei
3rd：Maeda Keiji

5th：Miyamoto Musashi
6th：Venus

10th：Nidaime Ibaraki Douji


[h3]Q.Please tell us which character you would like to see improved.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4d07ad767c3d43dcde5c04b4fb1ab5ea7f4004d3.png[/img]

6th：Abe no Seimei
7th：Venus
8th：Himiko
9th：Maeda Keiji
10th：Nidaime Ibaraki Douji


[hr][/hr][h2]Free Response[/h2]

[h3]Q. Please tell us about any equipment or skills you would like to see buffed.[/h3]

[b]Selected feedback regarding weapons, magatama, etc.[/b]
・Okada Izo Weapon
・Dragon Ark Weapons, Magatama
・Gargoyle Weapons, Magatama

[b]Selected feedback regarding skills, Ougi, etc.[/b]
・Improving the performance of currently implemented skills and Ougi for each weapon type
・Expanding Rain-element skills and Ougi
・Rebalancing the skill Punishment Cross

[h3]Q. Please share any other feedback or comments regarding Onigiri.[/h3]

[b]Selected feedback[/b]
・Adding features to improve gameplay convenience, such as expanding the scope of item search or farming functions
・Improving support so new players can play more easily
・Rebalancing the Vanguard character Kirigakure Saizo


[hr][/hr]
[h3]Team Comments[/h3]
Thank you very much for all of your responses.

Regarding dungeons, the majority of answers were [None in particular].
Going forward, we will continue to make efforts as a team to enhance and highlight the unique features of each dungeon, so that players can say [This is my favorite dungeon!] with confidence.

For the question about equipment and skills you would like to see buffed, we received a wide variety of opinions and concrete requests. We will take your feedback into consideration and proceed with adjustments to various equipment in the future.

In the free response section, we received many comments regarding system improvements to make the game easier to play, as well as suggestions for additional support for players just starting out. In addition, we also received numerous opinions about the adjustments made in July of this year. We will sincerely take all of your feedback into account and continue to strengthen our efforts.

Based on the results of this survey, we will work on updates that meet your expectations, so please look forward to them.

Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 9/4/2025 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Update Information[/h2]
[h3]・New Nyankoropon Added![/h3]
[b]■Limited-Time Character Revival: Second Half![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/77a03fe68cfaaa7d19c16dff67728589c198627d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2916f8ae5900972ee52693d14999e80954dd2a21.jpg[/img]

The limited-time characters will return in two parts: first half and second half!
In the second half, [b]Fuuma Kotarou[/b] and [b]Genbu[/b] will appear!

----------------------------------------------------------------

New Nyankoropon details can be found [url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/129004/web][b]here[/b][/url].
*Japanese language only

[b]◆Nyankoropon Period[/b]
　From maintenance 9/4/2025 JST
　Until maintenance 9/18/2025 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Gargoyle Weapons Reborn！[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8d9b496a582cb03a6f6b9cb4c0930b7b88678bb0.jpg[/img]

The weapons that can be crafted from [b]Assault! Infernal Gargoyle -Purgatorium-, Assault!Sleetsword Gargoyle -Purgatorium-, Assault!Levinlance Gargoyle -Purgatorium- Void Series[/b] are being reborn!
They can now be enhanced into the more powerful [b]Void -Strike- Series[/b], equipped with stronger Desperate abilities.

Be sure to check out the new strategies, such as secret skills that inflict status ailments useful when HP decreases, and options that make follow-up attacks more likely to occur the lower your HP gets!

Furthermore, the [b]Void -Strike- Series[/b] is also coming to Magatama!
Recipes will be added to the Exchange Shop before the Great Calamity Purge along with the weapons.

Additionally, Skill Cards for the new skills granted to the [b]Void -Strike- Series[/b]—[b]Flame Pillar Blast, Ice Pillar Blast, Lightning Pillar Blast[/b]—will also be added to the Exchange Shop.

※The appearance of the Void -Strike- Series will be the same as the original Void Series.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆ Gargoyle Triple Release & Dungeon Boost! ◆[/b]
To commemorate the release of the Void -Strike- Series, a special campaign will be held with the simultaneous release of three Gargoyle -Purgatorium- dungeons and a Dungeon Boost!
During the event, the [b]stamina cost of eligible dungeons will be reduced, and item drop rates from monsters will be increased by 100%[/b]!
※For details on the simultaneous release of the three Gargoyle -Purgatorium- dungeons, please check below.

[b]■ Eligible Dungeon Boost Targets[/b]
Assault! Infernal Gargoyle
Assault! Sleetsword Gargoyle
Assault! Levinlance Gargoyle
Assault! Crag Gargoyle
Assault! Infernal Gargoyle (Reward UP)
Assault! Sleetsword Gargoyle (Reward UP)
Assault! Levinlance Gargoyle (Reward UP)
Assault! Crag Gargoyle (Reward UP)
Assault! Infernal Gargoyle -Puragtorium-
Assault! Sleetsword Gargoyle -Purgatorium-
Assault! Levinlance Gargoyle -Purgatorium-

※Lucky Box and clear reward drop rates will not be affected by this campaign’s increased drop rates.
※During the campaign period, daily dungeons will be available every day.
※Only drop rate boosts will apply in Yomotsuhirasaka - Winds and Yomotsuhirasaka - Lightning.

In addition, the same Vanguard characters who have bonus effects in the currently running Dungeon Boost Part 2 will also receive special attack bonuses in the eligible dungeons!

[b]【Bonus Characters】[/b]
Izuna, Izuna Three-Tails, Dark Musashi, Uesugi Kenshin, Takeda Shingen
Sasaki Kojirou, Kojirou (Flying Swallow), Ibaraki Douji - Summer Sky, Murasaki Shikibu

[b]■ Unlocking Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
Players must clear the [To Kishinden] quest and speak to the NPC Chifuri
in the Temporal Rift in order to unlock these dungeons.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆ Upcoming Update Plans ◆[/b]
After the simultaneous release of the three Gargoyle -Purgatorium- dungeons ends, we plan to make these dungeons permanently available after a certain period.

When they become permanent, the current [Purgatorium Treasures] dropped will be changed to new items, and adjustments will be made to the required exchange amounts. With this adjustment, the number of items required for some exchanges may increase compared to the current Purgatorium Treasures. We kindly ask for your understanding.

Additionally, weapons crafted from Abyss Gargoyle and Lucifer will also receive rebirth updates in future patches.
We also plan to make balance adjustments to certain other items.
Please look forward to it!


[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Gargoyle -Purgatorium- Triple Release![/h3]
[b]To commemorate the release of the Void -Strike- Series[/b], three Purgatorium Dungeons [b]Assault! Infernal Gargoyle -Purgatorium- ,Assault!Sleetsword Gargoyle -Purgatorium-,  Assault!Levinlance Gargoyle -Purgatorium-[/b] will appear in the Purgatorium Dungeons.
In these dungeons, you can obtain not only regular items but also exclusive items such as [b]Purgatorium Treasure[/b].

[b]■ About Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
・Monsters in these dungeons have high elemental resistances, making it difficult to damage them with non-weakness elements. Their HP and attack power are also significantly strengthened.
・Clearing a Purgatorium Dungeon with a B Rank or higher will reward you with Purgatorium Treasure.
・When clearing the dungeon on the “God” difficulty, there is a very small chance to obtain powerful Magatama.

[b]■ Materials obtainable from Assault! Infernal Gargoyle -Purgatorium-[/b]
・From the boss Infernal Gargoyle of this dungeon, the following materials can drop:
　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Infernal Gargoyle’s Fang
　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Infernal Gargoyle’s Hand
　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Infernal Gargoyle’s Nucleus

[b]■ Materials obtainable from Assault!Sleetsword Gargoyle -Purgatorium-[/b]
・From the boss Sleet Gargoyle of this dungeon, the following materials can drop:
　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Fang
　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Hand
　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Nucleus

[b]■ Materials obtainable from Assault!Levinlance Gargoyle -Purgatorium-[/b]
・From the boss Levin Gargoyle of this dungeon, the following materials can drop:
　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Levin Gargoyle’s Fang
　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Levin Gargoyle’s Hand
　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Levin Gargoyle’s Nucleus

[b]■ About Purgatorium Treasure[/b]
・Purgatorium Treasure can be exchanged for various items with the NPC Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo.
・This NPC becomes available after clearing each of the following dungeon difficulties once: Jin, Kō, and Shin.
・Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo only appears while the Purgatorium Dungeons are active, and the exchange lineup changes depending on which dungeons are available.
・After the Purgatorium Dungeon event period ends, Purgatorium Treasure will transform into an item called Purgatorium Junk.
　When the Purgatorium Dungeons return in the future, you can exchange multiple Purgatorium Junks for Purgatorium Treasures at the Exchange.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/87c4f43e26d744aae21cfc5ea7415ace9aaad72c.jpg[/img]

In addition, a wide variety of luxurious items can be exchanged!

[b]Fuma Kotaro[/b] themed furniture will be added to the Shopping Plaza!

【Addendum 8/27】

Greetings from Onigiri Service Team.
We are holding a collaboration campaign with [b]toreba[/b] where you can get useful items!

In CyberStep’s online crane game [b]toreba[/b], special collaboration machines featuring [b]Onigiri[/b] will appear. Play on these machines to get a [b]serial code for in-game Onigiri items[/b]!

There are two types of collaboration machines: the [b]Free Play Machine[/b], which you can play once per day for free, and the [b]Paid Play Machine[/b], which you can play by spending Points (TP).

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Paid Play Machine[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/313af75d51145e572d6be66477f269799c77efed.jpg[/img]

The Paid Play Machine can be played by spending Points (TP). What item you’ll receive will be a surprise until you enter the serial code!
Prizes are limited to 120 in total and the campaign will end once they are gone.

[b]■Available Prizes[/b]
[table]
[tr][td]Items[/td][td]Quantity[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Free Onigiri Coins ×200[/td][td]30[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Smelting Amulet Transcendent Fortune ×4[/td][td]30[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Oranmentation Amulet Transcendent Fortune ×3[/td][td]30[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Max Durability +500 Ticket ×3[/td][td]30[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[h3]Free Play Machine[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c16ce0f01d4a39d2b4004fa7bc70bac6f9baf450.jpg[/img]

The Free Play Machine can be played only once per day.
The number of plays resets daily at 6:00 AM, so be sure to try it every day♪

[b]■Available Prizes[/b]
[table]
[tr][td]Item[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Gacha Ticket ×1[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[b]◆How to Play[/b]
[h2][b][url=https://www.toreba.net/landing/ad/OG-GAME-QR-250728-00001]Click here to play the collaboration machines![/url][/b][/h2]
*Clicking the link will take you to the official Treba website.

[b]◆How to Receive Your Items[/b]
The serial codes you obtain from the collaboration machines can be redeemed in Onigiri.
From the menu, go to “System” → “Serial Code” and enter your code to have the item sent to the Account tab of your Present Box.
*As long as it is on the same account where the code was entered, any character can claim the item.

[b]◆Event Period[/b]
　From 15:00 on 8/14/2025 JST
　Until 14:59 on 9/4/2025 JST [b]Extended![/b]
　[strike]2025年8月28日（木）14:59まで[/strike]

　◆Serial Code Redemption Period
　Until 23:59 on 9/30/2025 JST
　
[b]◆Notes[/b]
・Please note that the number of prizes available from the Paid Play Machines is limited.
・The contents of this campaign are subject to change without prior notice.
・The PS4 version of Onigiri is not eligible for this campaign.

notes.title: 【Addendum】New Character Sei Shonagon Added!
notes.content:
【Addendum 8/14】
・Added notes regarding buff duration.
・Revised the description of the poison effect.


Greeting from the Onigiri Service Team.

Starting Thursday, 9/18/2025, we are introducing the new Vanguard Swap Character
[b]Sei Shonagon[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/315a69a171f789af97465473ebfa71340349c349.png[/img]
VA: Natsunone Yuki

The Vanguard Swap Character [b]Sei Shonagon[/b] can be unlocked by using the item Summoner's Scroll - Sei Shonagon.
She will follow you and fight alongside you, and by performing a [b]Vanguard Swap[/b], you can take control of Sei Shonagon.

She is an axe-wielding character who battles by skillfully using her unique buff skill Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the Buff Skill Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c0a365380c304429510a6eb2199c8cbeb073d031.png[/img]

While Sei Shonagon’s primary attribute is [b]Poison[/b], she can [b]add four different attributes[/b] through her four buff skills [b]Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter[/b].

[b]Skill Spring Dawn[/b] adds [b]Wind attribute[/b] at 25% of skill power,
[b]Skill Summer Night[/b] adds [b]Thunder attribute[/b] at 25% of skill power,
[b]Skill Autumn Dusk[/b] adds [b]Water attribute[/b] at 25% of skill power,
[b]Skill Winter Daybreak[/b] adds [b]Holy attribute[/b] at 25% of skill power.
Additionally, each one [b]multiplies damage by 1.25[/b].

Up to four buff effects can be active at the same time.
[u]The effect duration is 30 seconds when in Vanguard Swap, and 20 seconds when accompanying.[/u]

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]■ About Attribute Addition[/b]
When under the buff effect of Spring Dawn, [b]Wind attribute is added at a value equal to 25% of the used skill’s power[/b].

Image example (with skill distribution shown as 100)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/d688077aa541bf4d9ec28dfc56b0c3ce8072476b.png[/img]

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]■ About Damage Multiplication[/b]
Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter increases [b]damage by 1.25x[/b] per buff effect, and when all buffs are active, [b]damage is doubled[/b].
During this, the damage cap is ignored.
*When applied to player characters, damage multiplication does not apply to monsters with the Covenant trait.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]■ Other Effects[/b]
Additionally, the buffs from Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter have the following effects:
・Corresponding Attribute +50
・Reduce the cooldown of the [Ougi Thorn Season Distant Yet Near] by 10 seconds
・Attack -10%
[u]・Inflicts Poison status that deals 100 damage per second[/u]
[strike]・Inflict Poison status for 20 seconds, dealing 150 damage per second[/strike]

Sei Shonagon constantly activates the buff Toxic Reversal, which converts poison damage into healing, allowing her to recover from poison damage.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]■ Applying Buffs to Others[/b]
Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, when activated, forcibly grants the buff to party members. Along with the buffs, the drawbacks of Poison status and Attack -10% are also applied, up to all four at once.

Depending on the monster, the drawback may reduce the damage dealt.
[b]Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter is a powerful buff, but be mindful that it also forcibly applies drawbacks![/b]

Additionally, even when accompanying you, Sei Shonagon may apply the Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter buff to player characters.

*Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter is only applied to player characters in the party and is not applied to Vanguard Characters or Battle Mounts.
*The poison damage from Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter will not reduce HP to 0; a minimum of 1 HP will be maintained.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Skill Slots[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/81141f6087a8688aaee17e6c09056beb212a7160.png[/img]

Sei Shonagon can freely set both regular skills and ougi skills in all of her skill slots.
The regular skills consist of the four buff skills from Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, while her other attack skills are classified as ougi skills.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Intro[/h3]
Some of Lady Daruma's Skills will be showcased below.
※Some skills may require an increase in Partner Level and Awakening to be used.


[b]■Ougi Thorn Season Six String Slam[/b]
Leap into the air and slam your guitar straight down.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/f1e1ab8013543d8266461c126abacf9fe0be0dd1.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Thorn Season Spiral Soundwave[/b]
Strum your guitar with all your might and fire sound bullets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e2e2c5712b5ce4671335d58474460debb2b92270.png[/img]

[b]■Ougi Thorn Season Distant Yet Near[/b]
Suddenly appearing alongside Murasaki Shikibu, perform a coordinated combo attack to strike enemies around you.
After the combo ends, bees will follow you for 10 seconds and automatically attack enemies. Each bee hit restores SP.
※Using Vanguard switch will also trigger a cooldown timer for this skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/76173e45ddfbc47d571a88eb10e54721ec2cbf4d.png[/img]


Join the unique guitarist [b]Sei Shonagon[/b] and put on a passionate stage performance!

※Images are taken during development.
※Update contents are subject to change without notice.

Thank you for your attention.
We appreciate your support for Onigiri!

The Summoner's Scroll - Sei Shonagon, which lets you recruit Sei Shonagon as an ally, can be obtained from the [b]Sei Shonagon Limited Nyankoropon[/b] in the Shopping Plaza!

The new avatar [b]Nagisa Hoodie[/b] makes its debut!
It will also be available in a pack, so be sure to check it out♪

The Avatar Nyankoropon lineup has been updated!
Avatars such as [b]Summer Yukata[/b] and [b]Incubus[/b] will appear!

----------------------------------------------------------------
In addition, the [b]Sea and Vacation Series[/b] furniture makes its return, and the [b]Special Nyankoropon[/b]—which guarantees at least one prize from the Platinum lineup—will also be available!
A Nyankoropon that can be spun with the [b]Summer Gift Gacha Ticket 2025[/b], obtainable through events and the login bonus calendar, will also appear♪

For details on the Nyankoropon lineup, please check [url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/128081/web][b]here[/b][/url].

[hr][/hr]
h3]・Event Onigashima Summer Music Festival Now Live![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/5b180c46d054ed03b254350df34769f4c9548775.jpg[/img]

This year’s summer festival is a music festival!
Together with Murasaki Shikibu and others who have come to Onigashima, the protagonist’s party decides to enjoy the festivities.
However, upon arriving at the venue, Murasaki Shikibu’s behavior seems… strange?

During the event period, the NPC Murasaki Shikibu will appear in front of Statue on Onigashima.
By speaking with her, you can progress through the event quests.

Clearing each event dungeon will earn you event items.
If certain conditions are met, you can obtain more event items upon clearing.

■Characters and Items with Bonuses
【Partner Characters】
　Sei Shonagon, Murasaki Shikibu, Sesshu, Ono no Komachi, Dark Musashi, Kenshin - Scarlet Bloom,
　Izuna, Amanokaju

【Accessories】

　Sei Shonagon's In-ear Monitor, Rockin' Hornet

※Select the Bonus button on the dungeon panel to confirm bonus details.
※Please be sure to use Summoning Scrolls prior to entering a Dungeon in order to be eligible for the Bonus.
※Please clear the dungeon with the target accessories equipped.

In this event, you can obtain the Manifestation Scroll for the event-limited battle mount Giant Beach Ball!

　Treasure Chest Nyankoropon (x16)

Please be aware of your surroundings and have fun when using it♪

During the event period, Assault! Levinlance Gargoyle, has been added to the purgatorium dungeons!
Players can obtain not only the regular rewards, but also Purgatorium Treasures from this challenge!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

[b]■About Items from the Levinlance Gargoyle Purgatorium dungeon[/b]
　・The Levinlance Gargoyle Purgatorium Boss will drop the following items:

　　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Levin Gargoyle’s Hand
　　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Levin Gargoyle’s Nucleus

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasures[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[h3]・[Roar, O Bullet of Magic!] Event Added![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4a43faf9f3ac37fd35622d34ad18727b224f7c7a.jpg[/img]

[b]~Summary~[/b]
This year the Summer Festival in Onigashima includes a Shooting Festival!
Nobunaga seems to have arrived with her retinue to take part!

During the event period, talk to [b]Oda Nobunaga[/b] in Onigashima to begin the quest.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆Event Item and Bonuses◆[/b]
Event items can be obtained by clearing each event dungeon. 
Also, under certain conditions, the number of evet items received upon clearing a dungeon will increase.

[b]■Bonus Character and Item List[/b]
[Partner Character]
　Oda Nobunaga - Thunderbolt,Oda Nobunaga, Hideyoshi, Katsuie, Mitsuhide, Nobunaga Incognito

[Accessory]

※Select the Bonus button on the dungeon panel to confirm bonus details.
※Please be sure to use Summoning Scrolls prior to entering a Dungeon in order to be eligible for the Bonus.
※Please clear the dungeon with the target accessories equipped.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆About the Sebas-chan Watermelon◆[/b]
Players can obtain the Battle Mount Sebas-chan Watermelon as a reward for the event!

[b]●How to obtain Manifestation Scroll - Sebas-chan Watermelon[/b]

※Sebas-chan Watermelon's Skills cannot be edited.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8b09000b7b95bde4348f1dd48e0a2c8bfac473cc.png[/img]

Sebas-chan Watermelon can use the current of normal combos to [b]drag friend's players along with it[/b]!

Enjoy you summer mischief and keep an eye on your surroundings~♪

----------------------------------------------------------------

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a19a3f504b564c12ab666d4f4106c55baf47bb0b.jpg[/img]

[Addendum 7/10]
-Bug fixes have been added.


Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 7/10/2025 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
・Fixed an issue where the Zenith Medal could not be obtained as a clear reward in Oni Mode of the dungeon Forest of Chaos Delirium.
Compensation items will be distributed in a future maintenance based on the number of Oni Mode clears during the affected period.

・Fixed an issue where the HP and SP gauge effects were displayed incorrectly.
The current effects were mistakenly implemented during the update on 7/3/2025 JST.
　We are currently reviewing potential changes to the gauge effects and plan to make adjustments in a future update.

[Addendum]
[u]・Fixed an issue in the dungeon Forest of Chaos Delirium where the boss could sometimes take damage even while invincible.[/u]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Others[/h2]
・Regarding the balance adjustments carried out on 7/3/2025 JST, we have determined that the previously distributed compensation was insufficient.
Therefore, additional compensation will be sent to characters those who obtained Summoner's Scroll - Kirigakure Saizo.

　For each Summoner's Scroll - Kirigakure Saizo obtained, the following items will be distributed.

　[b]■Compensation Items[/b]
　・Limited Gacha Ticket Exchange Item (Limited Exchange Ticket) *No Expiration ×10
　・Free OC ×300
　・Full Energy Restorative ×10
　・Gold Kompeitou ×50
　・Exp Boost +300% (60Min.) ×5
　・Ryou Boost +300% (60Min.) ×5
　・Drop Boost +300% (60Min.) ×5

　We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and trouble caused to all players.

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention!
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

notes.title: [Addendum]Regarding the balance adjustments on 7/3/2025 JST
notes.content:
【Addendum 7/4】
・Revised the description of the debuff effect for the skill [King Cross V~VII] due to previously unclear wording.


Greeting from Onigiri Service Team.

During the maintenance on 7/3/2025 JST, following balance adjustments will be made.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Regarding the balance adjustments to Kirigakure Saizo[/h3]

The adjustments details for Kirigakure Saizouare are as follows:

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Punishment Cross V～VII[/b]
・Slightly extends the timing window for skill cancel.

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Victory Cross(Non-Charged)[/b]
・Reduces the number of hits:
　30 → 10
・Increases the power reduction ratio when not charged.
※For SP changes, please refer to the charged version.

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Victory Cross V(Charged)[/b]
・Reduces the number of hits:
　30 → 15
・Increases SP cost:
　278 → 417
・The max damage boost now only applies when hitting enemies from behind.

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Victory Cross VI(Charged)[/b]
・Reduces the number of hits:
　30 → 20
・Increases SP cost:
　333 → 500
・The max damage boost now only applies when hitting enemies from behind.

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Victory Cross VII(Charged)[/b]
・Increases SP cost:
　500 → 750
・The max damage boost now only applies when hitting enemies from behind.
・SP reduction effects will no longer apply to its SP cost.

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: King Cross V[/b]
・Increases cooldown time:
　10s → 40s
・Increases SP cost:
　194 → 500
・SP reduction effects will no longer apply to its SP cost.
[u]・For debuffs that reduce the target's elemental values, the effect amount will now vary depending on whether a back attack was successful when attacking a debuffed enemy.[/u]
　[u]■ When a back attack is successful[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's slash attribute is fixed at -50[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's fire attribute is fixed at -50[/u]
　[u]■ When a back attack is not successful[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's slash attribute is reduced by 30[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's fire attribute is reduced by 30[/u]
　[u]※ The effect amount of the debuff is not determined at the moment [King Cross] hits the target. If a back attack is successful against an enemy already afflicted with the debuff, the attributes will be fixed at -50. Otherwise, the attributes will be reduced by 30.[/u]
・Debuff duration reduced:
　20 sec → 10 sec

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: King Cross VI[/b]
・Increases cooldown time:
　10 sec → 30 sec
・Increases SP cost:
　233 → 1000
・SP reduction effects will no longer apply to its SP cost.
[u]・For debuffs that reduce the target's elemental values, the effect amount will now vary depending on whether a back attack was successful when attacking a debuffed enemy.[/u]
　[u]■ When a back attack is successful[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's slash attribute is fixed at -50[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's fire attribute is fixed at -50[/u]
　[u]■ When a back attack is not successful[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's slash attribute is reduced by 30[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's fire attribute is reduced by 30[/u]
　[u]※ The effect amount of the debuff is not determined at the moment [King Cross] hits the target. If a back attack is successful against an enemy already afflicted with the debuff, the attributes will be fixed at -50. Otherwise, the attributes will be reduced by 30.[/u]

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: King Cross VII[/b]
・Increases cooldown time:
　10 sec → 20 sec
・Increases SP cost:
　350 → 1500
・SP reduction effects will no longer apply to its SP cost.
[u]・For debuffs that reduce the target's elemental values, the effect amount will now vary depending on whether a back attack was successful when attacking a debuffed enemy.[/u]
　[u]■ When a back attack is successful[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's slash attribute is fixed at -50[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's fire attribute is fixed at -50[/u]
　[u]■ When a back attack is not successful[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's slash attribute is reduced by 30[/u]
　　[u]● Enemy's fire attribute is reduced by 30[/u]
　[u]※ The effect amount of the debuff is not determined at the moment [King Cross] hits the target. If a back attack is successful against an enemy already afflicted with the debuff, the attributes will be fixed at -50. Otherwise, the attributes will be reduced by 30.[/u]
・Debuff duration extended:
　20 sec → 30 sec

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Demon Cross V[/b]
・Increases skill playback speed.
・Reduces number of hits:
　50 → 30
・Reduces cooldown time:
　12 sec → 5 sec

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Demon Cross VI[/b]
・Increases skill playback speed.
・Reduces number of hits:
　50 → 40
・Reduces cooldown time:
　60 sec → 25 sec

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Demon Cross VII[/b]
・Increases skill playback speed.
・Reduces number of hits:
　60 sec → 25 sec
・SP reduction effects will no longer apply to its SP cost.

[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Living Cross VII[/b]
・SP reduction effects will no longer apply to its SP cost.


[b]＜Regarding the Adjustment Policy＞[/b]
Kirigakure Saizou is characterized by dealing powerful damage through back attacks; however, we have determined that this characteristic was not being fully utilized and was, in fact, undermining the unique traits of other characters. Therefore, we have implemented a balance adjustment to address this unexcepted situation.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Balance Adjustments for Abe no Seimei[/h3]

The details of the adjustments for Abe no Seimei are as follows:

[b]■Skill Slots upon Vanguard Gauge Time[/b]
At the first Vanguard Gauge Time, skills will now be automatically set in skill slots 1 to 3.
The mask in the hand slot will be different from the skills set in the skill slots.
※Unable to choose which skills are set at the time of the first Vanguard Gauge Time.

[b]■Effect Change: Twelve Generals Mask - Ox[/b]
Before: Randomly increases the level of one mask set in the normal skill slots by 1
After: Increases the level of all masks set in the normal skill slots by 1

[b]■Behavior Changes While Selecting a Mask[/b]
When standing still and pressing the guard button to enter mask selection mode, the character will now enter a guard state.
This guard state will be canceled upon moving or using a skill.
If the guard button is pressed while moving, the guard state will not activate, and only mask selection will be available.
Additionally, when guard is activated, the character will face the camera direction and a special visual effect will be displayed during the guard state.

notes.title: 7/3/2025 JST Notice of Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
Greeting from Onigiri Service Team!

[h3]Notice Regarding Balance Adjustments and Compensation[/h3]
In order to create an environment where a wider variety of partner characters, both new and old, can thrive, we have decided to implement balance adjustments to certain characters and skills on 7/3/2025 JST. We sincerely apologize to all players using the affected characters, as these changes may significantly impact your gameplay experience.

The balance adjustments will target the vanguard characters Kirigakure Saizou and Abe no Seimei, as well as the player skill Punishment Cross. Details regarding the specific adjustments will be announced at a later date.

As an apology for the balance adjustments, the following items will be distributed to all accounts during the maintenance.

[b]■Compensation Items[/b]
・Limited Gacha Ticket Exchange Item (no expiration) ×5
・Free Onigiri Coins ×300
・Skill Slot Glue ×10

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused.
Thank you for your continued support of Onigiri.

Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 6/19/2025 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
・Fixed an issue where dropped items would disappear in the following situations when the automatic pickup feature is enabled.
　● When the inventory is full and a stack of two or more units of a new item not already in the inventory drops.
　● When two or more recovery items with different stack counts between the inventory and warehouse drop, and picking them up would exceed the inventory’s carrying limit, the items are lost without notification. Additionally, if this bug occurs while other items drop simultaneously, those items may also disappear.
　Compensation items for this bug will be sent during the maintenance period.

・Fixed an issue where the dungeon portal for the main quest [To Onigashima] would not appear, blocking the progression of certain tasks.

・As it was identified that the per-unit price of the [Life Sigil of Luck] and [Life Sigil of Great Fortune] 3-piece sets was equal to or higher than the price of individual units during the Shopping Plaza Sale, compensation will be sent to affected players.

[h2]Update Information[/h2]
・Regarding the Auto-Collect Feature for Dropped Items, the behavior when multiple items are dropped simultaneously will be adjusted.

　After the change: Items that can fit into the inventory will be auto-collected, and only the remaining items will be dropped.

　　　Hard Difficulty → Headless Warrior's Horn

・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items

notes.title: Regarding the balance adjustments for Assist Characters on 5/15/2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a19a3f504b564c12ab666d4f4106c55baf47bb0b.jpg[/img]

Greeting from Onigiri Service Team!

During the maintenance on 5/15/2025, we will implement balance adjustments for Assist Characters.

The details of the adjustments are as follows.[hr][/hr]
[h3]Adjustment to Incoming Damage[/h3]
The incoming damage calculation formula will be adjusted to reduce damage taken compared to the previous formula.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Addition of Attribute Values[/h3]
All Assist Characters will now have designated strong and weak attributes.

Strong attributes will be assigned with a positive initial value, which can be further increased as the character levels up.

Weak attributes will be assigned with a negative initial value, but leveling up to level 100 will bring them back to zero.

Details on the attribute increases can be checked in the Status screen under the Effects & Bonuses tab.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Addition of Recovery Skills[/h3]
All Assist Characters will receive a skill that restores their own HP by a percentage when their attacks hit.
Recovery skills can be identified by the -Recovery- suffix in their skill names.
To unlock these skills, the Friendship Level must be raised to Lv 140.
The newly added skills are as follows:

[b]■Gargoyle[/b]
・Grief Inferno Recovery

[b]■Parvus Gargoyle[/b]
・Grief Inferno Recovery

[b]■Satan[/b]
・Brilliant Falls Recovery

[b]■Tohoku Kiritan[/b]
・Killfire Kiritan Recovery

[b]■Rumi Gargoyle[/b]
・Gel Grief Recovery

[b]■Elle Gargoyle[/b]
・Thundering Grief Recovery

[b]■Kotonoha Aoi[/b]
・Wintry Rush Recovery

[b]■Kotonoha Aoi - Summer Song[/b]
・Wintry Rush Recovery

[b]■Lucifer[/b]
・Advent Cross Recovery

[b]■Ahriman[/b]
・Gloomy Glow Recovery


[hr][/hr]
[h3]Buff Effect Visualization[/h3]
When receiving buff effects such as Attack Power Up from Assist Characters, a buff icon will now be displayed.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Power Adjustment[/h3]
Except for certain skills, the power of most skills will be increased.
The following skills are excluded from the power increase or will have minimal change in damage output after the adjustment.

notes.title: New Character Lady Daruma Added!
notes.content:
Greeting from Onigiri Service Team!

From 5/15/2025, a new Assist Character, [b]Lady Daruma[/b], will be introduced!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/54a298bab1159f6f066756954e5257c2955aad31.png[/img]
VA: Momozono Riel

The Assist Character [b]Lady Daruma[/b] can be unlocked by using the item Covenant Scroll - Lady Daruma.
She will follow behind you and fight alongside you, providing support such as buffs to the player.

Lady Daruma specializes in supporting [b]Mountain Element[/b], [b]Wind Element[/b], and [b]Slash Element[/b].
Additionally, she can use a [b]skill that protects the player from stun[/b].

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Intro[/h3]
Some of Lady Daruma's Skills will be showcased below.
※Some skills may require an increase in Partner Level and Awakening to be used.

[b]■Servant Toss: Mountain[/b]
Throw the Servant Daruma to attack. Lowers target's Mountain Element for a certain period of time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/7093ee41ad66ceefeda629089dc09f5f454537fa.png[/img]


[b]■Servant Charge[/b]
Send Servant Daruma to charge attack. Lowers enemies' Slash Element for a certain period of time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/f67de8546d867f0d75422f24992286fb7532b7ee.png[/img]


[b]■Daruma Tumble: Stun[/b]
Play with Daruma Tumble.
Recovers player's stunned state and grants stun resistance for a certain period. Additionally, restores the player's HP.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/7df6b424d808e406079532df933ffdbdc5de6410.png[/img]


[b]■Daruma Tumble: Slash - Wind[/b]
Play with Daruma Tumble.
For a certain period of time, converts the Slash Element of the player's skills to the Wind Attribute.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/71615c59cf121e6d289baef6df39982ce0e10c16.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]
Let’s go on an adventure with the 41st Chief Daruma Candidate, [b]Lady Daruma[/b]!

※Images are created during development and are subject to change.
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your attention!
We appreciate your support for Onigiri!

notes.content:

[b]■Ieyasu Limited Nyankoropon！[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e793ebca4925e88383008bfd1e8965412b329570.jpg[/img]

Vanguard Character [b]Tokugawa Ieyasu[/b] will be boosted for a limited time.

During the campaign, [b]Tokugawa Ieyasu's damage against Specter (S) type monsters will be increased[/b]!
Additionally, while using Tokugawa Ieyasu as a Vanguard, [b]defeating Specter (S) type monsters grants +100% drop rate[/b]!

The enhancements in this campaign are part of a trial implementation related to potential future upgrades for partner characters.
The results of this trial will be used for reference in future developments.

※The drop rate increase does not apply to certain items such as Lucky Boxes or dungeon clear rewards.

[b]◆Campaign Period[/b]
　From maintenance 4/17/2025 JST
　Until maintenance 5/15/2025 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・[Dancing on Wings of Cosmic Balance] Event Second Half Begins![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/df09c91c62f482c078f3bdb04968470b98daffa8.jpg[/img]

[b]~ Synopsis ~[/b]
The party trains hard to be able to face the crisis against the world.
Where in the world has Keiji been taken to? What is the true identity of the man from the parallel world?

Progress through the [Dancing on the Wings of Cosmic Balance] first half event in order
 to undertake the [Dancing on the Wings of Cosmic Balance] second half.

During the event period, speak to the NPC Katashiro in Onigashima in order to begin the event quests.
※The main quest [Between Ages] and [The Imperial Capital, Edo]
　must be completed to undertake this quest.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆Event Item and Bonuses◆[/b]
Event items can be obtained by clearing each event dungeon. 
Also, under certain conditions, the number of evet items received upon clearing a dungeon will increase.

[b]■Bonus Character and Item List[/b]
[Partner Character]
　Abe no Seimei, Maeda Keiji, Honda Tadakatsu, Amakusa Shiro, Tokugawa Ieyasu
　Mitsuhide Akechi, Yagyu Jubei, Sesshu

[Accessory]
　Seymey, Kayjee, Tadakachu, Sheeroh, Ieyashu
　Meechuheeday, Jyuubei, Sesshu
　12 Generals Masks

※Select the Bonus button on the dungeon panel to confirm bonus details.
※Please be sure to use Summoning Scrolls prior to entering a Dungeon in order to be eligible for the Bonus.
※Please clear the dungeon with the target accessories equipped.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆Event Rewards◆[/b]
Clear the event to unlock Abe no Seimei's event exchange.
Exchange the event items Moon Stone, Sun Stone, and Celestial Palm Stone for limited time rewards.

■Exchange Item List
[table]
[tr][td][b]Type[/b][/td][td][b]Item[/b][/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Accessory[/td][td]Twelve Generals Mask - Rat[/td][/tr]

[tr][td]Recipe[/td][td]Dimension Tear Sword - Unsigned[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Recipe[/td][td]Dimension Tear Sword Mod - Unsigned[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Recipe[/td][td]Dimension Tear Sword - Mauchi[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a87bbafe6f646979d131245b026b68aed706b619.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/325f192a981b8b60ae49ce94c3ffb8793a39d9c3.png[/img]

※The recipe for the Dimension Series available at the exchange shop is the same as the one obtainable from the dungeon Operation Destruction Prevention.
※The quest Dancing on the Wings of Cosmic Balance Part 1 and the exchange shop will remain available until the end of Part 2, but the Part 1 achievements will end on 4/17/2025 JST.

[b]◆Event Period[/b]
　From maintenance 4/17/2025 JST
　Until maintenance 5/15/2025 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Purgatorium Dungeon Added![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/5b62aee6832169c20c42f0059480194f3d688c1a.jpg[/img]

During the event period, the warding dungeon [b][Assault! Cursect Princess -Puragtorium-][/b] will be available.
Purgatorium dungeons appear irregularly, but you can get the exclusive Purgatorium Treasure items!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　　The Cursect Princess also has a [b]Special Resistance Acquisition[/b] that increases her 
　　resistances based on the attribute of the attack received. These values will gradually return to normal.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

[h3]■About Items from the [Assault! Cursect Princess -Puragtorium-] dungeon[/h3]
　・The following items will be dropped from the boss monster Cursect Princess.

　　　Normal Difficulty → Cursect Gossamer Wings
　　　Hard Difficulty → Cursect Armored Jaw
　　　Hell Difficulty → Cursect Poison Needle

[h3]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasure[/h3]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but 
the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[b]■Exchange Item Samples[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/91f496da2370f5fd72483aa3122bbeec4e19a621.png[/img]

[/table]

In addition, a new furniture — the [b]Cursect Princess Figure[/b] — will be available by clearing the Oni difficulty 30 times!
Plus, the hanging scroll [b]Cursect Princess Kakejiku Purgatory[/b] makes a return!
To commemorate the debut of the figurine, the dungeon will be available for 4 weeks!
Don’t miss your chance to get this striking and impressive figurine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/54164ed7b98b6b06a45896765ea6523f2f91c249.png[/img]


[b]◆Purgatorium Availability[/b]
　From maintenance 4/17/2025 JST

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a19a3f504b564c12ab666d4f4106c55baf47bb0b.jpg[/img]

[Addendum 4/10]
・Details about the Kawanagajima Dungeons have been added.
・Details regarding the number change of channels have been added.


Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 4/10/2024 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Update Information[/h2]
[h3]・New dungeons added in Kawanakajima! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/287bb78d96d9503b51d08c193376bbcc7a0b6038.jpg[/img]

New dungeons added in field [Kawanakajima].
Kawanakajima is a field that becomes accessible by progressing through the quest [Distant Tiger and Dragon], which can be accepted by talking to the NPC  [Ihee the Wholesaler] in Onigashima.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]■New dungeon unlock quest added![/b]
If you have completed the quest [Distant Tiger and Dragon],  the quest [Faint Moonlight] will become available from the NPC Uesugi Kenshin in Kawanakajima.
By progressing through this quest, you will gain access to the new dungeons: [b][Crooked Caves Miasmic Skies][Amatsumihira Miasmic Skies][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ce2c647a78814dea068c3562e7cc94deda8d6608.png[/img]

Some of the monsters in [Crooked Caves Miasmic Skies] and [Amatsumihira Miasmic Skies] possess a new special resistance [b][Covenant][/b].

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]■Magatama recipe drops resumed & new Magatama added![/b]
The drops for the previously suspended recipes, "Mukade Magatama Recipe" and "Giant Mukade Magatama", will resume.
[u][Addendum]
Note: Along with the addition of the new magatamas, recipe drop rates will be adjusted across all dungeons in Kawanagajima[/u]

Additionally, new magatamas which enhance the power of Wand and Stave have been implemented: "Bone Magatama" and "Thousand Bone Magatama", .
Note: With the addition of new magatama, monster placements in the dungeons [Amatsumihira] and [Amatsumihira Miasma] have been adjusted.

Furthermore, [b]Enhanced versions of each magatama[/b] as well as [b]New Special Magatama[/b] have also been added.
Recipes for these enhanced and special magatama can be obtained in the newly added dungeons.

----------------------------------------------------------------

Don’t miss out on the newly expanded contents in Kawanagajima!

[hr][/hr]
・Adjustments will be made to the player skills [Ougi Fuujin/Raijin - VI] and [Ougi Fuujin/Raijin - Sublime].
　Both skills were previously dealing more damage than indicated due to internal settings. Additionally, [Ougi Fuujin/Raijin - Sublime] was outputting higher damage than [Ougi Fuujin/Raijin - VI] which was not intended. The following adjustments will be implemented:

　[b]■Ougi Fuujin/Raijin - VI[/b]
　・Decreasing damage dealt
　　※ The displayed damage value will be increased.
　・Reducing cooldown time

　[b]■Ougi Fuujin/Raijin - Sublime[/b]
　・Increasing damage dealt
　　※ The displayed damage value will be increased.
　・Reducing cooldown time

[u][Addendum]
・The number of channels in the following fields will be changed.
　Kawanagajima：1 → 2[/u]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
・Fixed an issue where the skill animation for [Tabu Yaksha Miroku] used by the Vanguard Swap character [Sanguine Tabu - Return Yaksha] would not play correctly.

・Other details have been adjusted.


[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention!
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0b205e40ec3fe2b5cf74efc1eb46c4772127bf76.jpg[/img]

During the event period,  Assault! Lucifer Purgatorium, has been added to the purgatorium dungeons!
Players can obtain not only the regular rewards, but also Purgatorium Treasures from this challenge!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.

　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.

　・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
　・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
　・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
　　available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
　・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, 
　　but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Update Information[/h2]
[h3]・the Identify screen UI has been updated[/h3]
Increasing the Identify limit and adjusting the UI for the "Identify" system in the Partner Ability with NPC "Shizuka Gozen".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1494c0629bff8c8c76b99e0f8bb23fc8f961e60a.png[/img]

The main changes are as follows.

[b]●Increasing Identify limit[/b]
The number of ??? weapons that can be indentified at once will be increased to 50.
[b]●Updating the display of ??? weapons in the indentify slots[/b]
??? weapons will now be displayed by type, and the quantity can be selected. Similar to NPC "Miroku"'s "Purchase" system, you can directly input the quantity or use right-click on the arrow buttons to increase or decrease to the maximum or minimum amount.
[b]●Implemented an "Auto add to limit" button[/b]
An "Auto add to limit" button will be added to the bottom-left of the Identify Panel. When pressed, ??? weapons will be added to the identify slots from the top of the list until the maximum limit is reached.

Other UI adjustments will also be made.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
・Fixed an issue where all element were set to 0 for the following monsters.
　Look Up Nyuudou（Isolated Research Facility Control Tower）
　MK-LVII（Storage Warehouse）※Boss Stage
　MK-LVII Modded（Storage Warehouse）
　Mud Boat Tanuki（Rainbow Cove）
　Infernal Mukade（Rainbow Cove）

・Fixed an issue where a forced crash would occur when using the Vanguard Character [Kirigakure Saizou's] skill [Secret Arts: Trick Cross] and escaping the dungeon while a decoy clone remained.

・Fixed an issue where the camera behaved unexpectedly when the player used the skill [Ougi Majestic Massacre].

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Others[/h2]
・Some items that drop across all fields, such as "Friendship Pendant" and other Partner items, as well as items from past April Fools' events, were previously labeled as not being affected by any Drop Boosts. However, these itfected by Drop Boosts as per current specifications.
There are no changes to the actual mechanics—the issue was with the incorrect description. We apologize for the error and have corrected it.
Affected items include Partner items, "Carrot", and previously introduced items like "Oni Love Heart". Please note that Lucky Boxes are not affected by any Drop Boosts.
Additionally, the item descriptions for "Oni Love Heart" and "Dragon Strawberry" have been updated to match the correct specifications.

・As compensation for the issue fixed during the emergency maintenance on 3/21/2025 JST — where players could not receive clear rewards in the dungeon "Operation Destruction Prevention（Limited）" unless cleared with an SS rank—we will be sending out compensation items.
These include guaranteed drops upon dungeon clear, as well as Lucky Boxes that may contain items like "Exceptional Clove Oil" and recipe items.

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention!
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.
※Images are created during development and are subject to change.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

notes.title: [addendum]New Character Kirigakure Saizo Added!
notes.content:
[addendum 12/19]
-The images in the “About Back Attacks” section have been corrected.
[addendum 12/20]
-Some notations have been corrected to English.


Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

On the 1/1/2025 JST update, the new vanguard 
[b]Kirigakure Saizo[/b] will have her skills featured below!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/910520e0b2a2be67552adbe2415168bd1c559c8c.png[/img]
VA：Megu Sakuragawa
Illustrator：Shitiken Nana（7th_knights）

The vanguard [b]Kirigakure Saizo[/b] can join  
your team by using a [b]Summoner's Scroll - Kirigakure Saizo[/b].
By using the [b]Vanguard Swap[/b] players can even take control of her themselves!

Using an Oodachi, she specializes in bloody fire magic and rear attacks.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Back Attacks[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/bbe4916d8ec852ebafc203e84fdef3532fa55a00.png[/img]

Kirigakure Saizo attacks from the rear of her opponents, [b]dealing significantly more damage[/b].
Utilize your combos or skills to get behind your enemy and deal crippling blows!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Basic Combos[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3b48e27a89229133968b8207603c8b9b4a75b788.png[/img]

Kirigakure Saizo's basic combos utilize inputting the left and right movement keys, [b]which allows for rotating around targeted opponents. [/b]
This useful action makes getting behind the enemy for back attacks easier!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Summoning[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/783dd0d16d7b6955840cf1aa16b6cfecf9fef4e2.png[/img]

When Saizo has been summoned, she will attack enemies nearby even if the player has not aggro'd any.
But, if there are no enemies nearby...?

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Introduction[/h3]
Some of Saizo's skills will be showcased below.
※Skill acquisition requires increasing your partner level and awakening level.


[b]■Secret Arts: Trick Cross[/b]
Summons a decoy clone to lure away the enemy's attention, concelaing the caster in a pool of blood to attack from the rear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/02c9b4a224a784bd725001ba095387ef150987da.png[/img]


[b]■Secret Arts: Bloodline Rampage[/b]
A buff skill that awakens blod within the body to bring forth latent power.
Can be recast multiple times.
■Buff Effect
・ATK Power up
・Raises upper damage limit
・Recovers a set amount of SP every second
・Successful back attacks recover HP
・Movement speed increases
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2669909e6e7402f274c2a556b5339f3d02c63c33.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: King Cross[/b]
Attack opponents with your own blood to dominate them.
Enemy slash and fire attributes will be dropped by 50 for a set time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3c2ec23f3af205e33eacb7ebc12335aea6c5c84e.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Demon Cross[/b]
Unleash a barrage of consecutive attacks.
Attacks from behind that land will recover a percentage of HP.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/81dca127655ff2acdfb7f5c5b87b7c76700f20d0.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Secret Arts: Living Cross[/b]
A long-distance attack that consumes the user's HP and sprays blood at the enemy.
When used, it removes debuffs, and can be used regardless of debuff status.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8e8e77b449802f80ea96a0324865524e7f8123cf.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]
Run across the battlefield as on of the Sanada Ten Braves, [b]Kirigakure Saizo[/b], and light up the battlefield with blazing blood!

※ Images are taken during development.
※ Update contents and dates are subject to change without notice.

Thank you for your attention.
We hope you will enjoy these updates for Onigiri!

notes.title: New Character Loyal Soldier Yoshitsune Added!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

It's our pleasure to introduce the skill of the newly added vanguard character, 
[b]Loyal Soldier Yoshitsune[/b], added on 11/21/2024 JST!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/9f68a2b97a3bb17ec3f024e14e3fdb1b6576f46a.png[/img]
VA：Eriko Matsui
Illustrator: Wakaba

The new vanguard [b]Loyal Soldier Yoshitsune[/b] can be unlocked 
by using the Summoner's Scroll Loyal Soldier Yoshitsune item.
She will battle by your side, but with a [b]Vanguard Swap [/b] you can take control of her!

With her ice imbued sword, she attacks with well timed counters to deal massive damage!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the Counter System[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e0e773a747ef19e879adf81bf7b443bb10078838.png[/img]

Loyal Soldier Yoshitsune is equipped with a [b]Counter System[/b] on many of her attacks.
Skills with a [counter mark to the right of the skill slot at the bottom of the screen will instantly go into [b]counter stance[/b] if the activation button is pressed again while executing the skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/9cb463904c7f74c0919499c39e98051ca1bc4337.png[/img]

When receiving an attack from an enemy while in counter stance, a powerful counter attack will be activated without consuming SP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e9f868162f91cdd13f22e981b02877f1c12eca4b.png[/img]

The specific counter action will vary based on the skill.
Watch your opponent's movements and strike with a carefully timed counter move!


[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Support while Summoned[/h3]

When Loyal Soldier Yoshitsune is summoned, she will grant the [b]Whetter's Knowledge buff, which has a chance of restoring weapon durability[/b].
When weapon durability is restored, the amount will display in green numbers on the weapon icon at the bottom of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a69288799cd56233684a55a0d851524e22a7c46e.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Intro[/h3]
Some of Loyal Soldier Yoshitsune's Skills will be showcased below.
※Some skills may require an increase in Partner Level and Awakening to be used.

[b]■Source Blade Mobile Ice[/b]
Jump with an upward spin before slamming the blade down.
Counter Skill：Instantly moves to the opponent's location and attacks with a spinning strike.
※Counter may not move under certain circumstances.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ec0363388da65eb684555d609fb7aa12f9d461fb.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Source Blade Double Champion[/b]
Draw from a sheathed stance to attack everyone in the vicinity with a powerful spinning slash.
Counter Skill：Perform another spinning slash.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/742c731d9611643b2980ea92a8a6b6bd7b5a8843.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Source Blade Ice Formation[/b]
Attacks by launching multiple blades of ice along the ground.
Counter Skill：Fires an additional slash that creates a block of ice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/972837a4b63bb591a9237abc7d14153df40000dd.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]
Race across the battlefield with [b]Loyal Soldier Yoshitsune[/b], empowered with new resolve!

※Images are created during development and are subject to change.
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your attention!
We appreciate your support for Onigiri!

[h3]・Purgatorium Dungeon Added![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/fb0cf3bc0fff22fc8abe9a8570db7a0878c99bdb.jpg[/img]

During the event period, Assault! Sleetsword Gargoyle, has been added to the purgatorium dungeons!
Players can obtain not only the regular rewards, but also Purgatorium Treasures from this challenge!。

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

[b]■About Items from the Sleetsword Gargoyle Purgatorium dungeon[/b]
　・The Sleetsword Gargoyle Purgatorium Boss will drop the following items:

　　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Fang
　　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Hand
　　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Nucleus

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasures[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

　　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Levin Gargoyle’s Nucleus

・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

Newly viewable stories have been added to the [b]Playback Function[/b].
This update will include the Main Sory up to the [b][To Mount Kurama][/b] quest.

[b]■How to Use[/b]
The Playback Function can be accessed from  the [Menu] → [Story] → [Playback].
After selecting the quest title of want you to view, press the [Play] button to start the scene.

[b]■About Viewable Quests[/b]
Titles of the quests/events that can be viewed will be displayed in a list, provided that prerequisite quests have been cleared.
The title names will typically be the same as the relevant quest names, but depending on the scene being played, some may have special titles (For example：[Prologue ~ Training in Onigashima], etc）.

[hr][/hr]
・The Playback function will now maximize effect range when playing event movies.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
・A bug where NPC names would not display in the field has been fixed.

・An issue where NPCs who were intended to be hidden would remain visible on the field when speaking with an NPC has been fixed.

・An issue where unintentional models would temporarily appear in certain locations while moving in the field has been fixed.

・An issue where certain characters would display unintentional motions during Main Quest event movies has been fixed.

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention!

notes.title: New Character [Oda Nobunaga - Thunderbolt] Added!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

On the 8/22/2024 JST update, the new vanguard 
[b]Oda Nobunaga - Thunderbolt[/b] will be added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/bc991d71c5e8eadcd40c9c9ecc174a6986098f88.png[/img]
VA：Sumire Uesaka

Players can add [b]Oda Nobunaga - Thunderbolt[/b] to their roster by 
using the Summoner's Scroll - Oda Nobunaga Thunderbolt item.
By using the [b]Vanguard Swap[/b] players can even take control of her themselves!

Nobunaga uses a [Three Shot] system with her electric bow type weapon.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the Three Shot System[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/bbb263595b7d0eff3b4c36325796c77353c6a2b5.png[/img]

All of Oda Nobunaga - Thunderbolt's skills belong to the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd stage categories, and the subsequent skills are strengthened when used in proper sequential order.

Also, Basic Combo, Dash, and Jump attacks are all considered Stage 1 attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ac4543a6587afb04d5517387aad6e43e8c841265.png[/img]

When a stage 1 skill is used, a countdown begins in which a stage 2 skill can be used. If a stage 2 skill is used within that time,  buffs granting boons such as  increased damage or number of hits will be activated. This flow remains the same for the 2nd to 3rd stage skills, but the buffs will vary dependent on the skill that is used.
The combo time allotment is 20 seconds, and the remaining time can be checked by hovering the mouse over the bullet gauge on the panel or on the buff icon.

Example 1：
[Stage 1] Arrival of Heaven
　　↓
[Stage 2] Nukijambu (Progression from stage 1 to 2 applies buffs)
　　↓
[Stage 3] Eternal Lightning (Progression from stage 2 to 3 applies buffs)

Example 2：
[Stage 1] Arrival of Heaven
　　↓
[Stage 2] Bullet Rain (Progression from stage 1 to 2 applies buffs)
　　↓
[Stage 2]Heavens Collapse (No progression, counter is reset)

There are no buffs applied for the Stage 1 Skill, but when the Stage 1 Skill is used the combo timer for a Stage 2 skill begins immediately.

Consider a combination of skills that suits your play style and unleash a powerful Three Shot assault!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the [Impurity Purge] Skill[/h3]

Using the skill Impurity Purge will cause Nobunaga to float in the air, allowing the player to shoot from the air where the cursor indicates using the mouse or gamepad stick.

The player will be invincible while the skill is active, and the skill will end when the bullets displayed in the bottom right corner are exhausted.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Introduction[/h3]
Some skills will be showcased below.
※Skill acquisition requires increasing your partner level and awakening level.

[b]■[Stage 1] Thunder Demon Sky Blossom[/b]
Roll forward to close the distance and fire!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/17bcbbe0c68025c14754bf98b94ff3e05ddf3ebf.png[/img]


[b]■[Stage 2] Thunder Demon Arrival of Heaven[/b]
Thrust the gun forward, firing a burstof bullets at close range.

On the 8/22/2024 JST update, the new vanguard 
[b]Oda Nobunaga - Thunderbolt[/b] will be added!

Players can add [b]Oda Nobunaga - Thunderbolt[/b] to their roster by 
using the Summoner's Scroll - Oda Nobunaga Thunderbolt item.
By using the [b]Vanguard Swap[/b] players can even take control of her themselves!
Nobunaga uses a [Three Shot] system with her electric bow type weapon.
All of Oda Nobunaga - Thunderbolt's skills belong to the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd stage categories, and the subsequent skills are strengthened when used in proper sequential order.
Also, Basic Combo, Dash, and Jump attacks are all considered Stage 1 attacks.

When a stage 1 skill is used, a countdown begins in which a stage 2 skill can be used. If a stage 2 skill is used within that time,  buffs granting boons such as  increased damage or number of hits will be activated. This flow remains the same for the 2nd to 3rd stage skills, but the buffs will vary dependent on the skill that is used.
The combo time allotment is 20 seconds, and the remaining time can be checked by hovering the mouse over the bullet gauge on the panel or on the buff icon.
Using the skill Impurity Purge will cause Nobunaga to float in the air, allowing the player to shoot from the air where the cursor indicates using the mouse or gamepad stick.
The player will be invincible while the skill is active, and the skill will end when the bullets displayed in the bottom right corner are exhausted.

■[Stage 1] Thunder Demon Sky Blossom
Roll forward to close the distance and fire!

*Japanese language only.

[b]◆Nyankoropon Availability[/b]
　After maintenance 8/8/2024 JST
　Until maintenance 8/22/2024 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Purgatorium Dungeon Added![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/5b62aee6832169c20c42f0059480194f3d688c1a.jpg[/img]

During the event period, the warding dungeon [b][Assault! Cursect Princess -Puragtorium-][/b] will be available.
Purgatorium dungeons appear irregularly, but you can get the exclusive Purgatorium Treasure items!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　　The Cursect Princess also has a [b]Special Resistance Acquisition[/b] that increases her 
　　resistances based on the attribute of the attack received. These values will gradually return to normal.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

[h3]■About Items from the [Assault! Cursect Princess -Puragtorium-] dungeon[/h3]
　・The following items will be dropped from the boss monster Cursect Princess.

　　　Normal Difficulty → Cursect Gossamer Wings
　　　Hard Difficulty → Cursect Armored Jaw
　　　Hell Difficulty → Cursect Poison Needle

[h3]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasure[/h3]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but 
the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[b]■Exchange Item Samples[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/91f496da2370f5fd72483aa3122bbeec4e19a621.png[/img]

[tr][td]Weapon Recipe[/td][td]Cursect Killer - Metamorphosis Recipe[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Magatama Recipe[/td][td]Cursect Magatama - Metamorphosis Recipe[/td][/tr]
[/table]

Look forward to many other great items as well!

Additionally, certain achievements will be available based on the number of clears at Hell difficulty!

[h3]◆Dungeon Availability Period[/h3]
　From maintenance 8/8/2024 JST
　Until maintenance 8/22/2024 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Summer Chat Added to MyRoom![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/21fda5c8b5baaa2089c1f5b569833116cb450300.jpg[/img]

For a limited time, Partner Characters will have [b]Summer Conversations[/b] when visiting MyRoom!
Talk to them during the period below for a chance to hear their thoughts on the season~

Some characters will even have newly added voiced lines!
Don't miss out on this chance.

※Some of these Summer Conversations will be the same as those spoken during past events.
※The same Summer Conversations may feature in future events.

[b]◆Summer Conversation Period[/b]
　After maintenance 8/8/2024 JST
　Until maintenance 8/22/2024 JST


[hr][/hr]
・A Login Bonus Calendar in which all rewards have been obtained will no longer be displayed upon logging in.
The completed Login Bonus Calendar can be viewed by going to [My Character] → [Login Calendar] from the Main Menu.

・In the quest progress display present on the right side of the screen, a field name will be added to the task displayed when speaking or reporting to an NPC.
　Example：Report to Kiichihougen [u]in Onigashima[/u]

・The timing of the information banner that displays upon login will be adjusted.

・The timing of facial expressions when talking with certain partner characters in MyRoom will be adjusted.


[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
・An issue where Presents which were sent as a result of the suspension of Steam Onigiri's Bazaar function on 8/1/2024 JST could not be received if the number of combined  items exceeded maximum possession limit will be fixed.
　To accomodatevthis issue, we will separate listed items that cannot currently be received from the Present Box into individual quantities. Along with this error, the receipt deadline for returned Bazaar will be extended by 7 days.
　Players logging in from this point forward will be able to receive their items in individual Presents.
　[strike]※Ietms which were for sale and have been returned to the Present Box as detailed above will not be separated if their item count exceeds 300. If the items are bundled together and you continue to have issues receiving your items, please send us a message via the inquiry form.[/strike]

・An issue where the Partner Character Himiko would have Valentines themed conversations when in MyRoom if the relevant quest had been completed has been fixed.

[hr][/hr]
Other details can be found here.
[h3][url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/117364/web]8/8 Update Contents[/url][/h3]
*Japanese language only

Thank you for your attention!
※Images are created during development and are subject to change.
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!
