Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 8/1/2024 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Update Information[/h2]
[b][IMPORTANT][/b]
・On the Steam Version of Onigiri, the player Bazaar function will be permanently disabled.
　Details about the function can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/290470/view/4163095972095144783] here[/url].
　Along with this change, the Bazaar icon will be removed from the Main Menu's UI.
　Items on sale at the Bazaar[u], as well any uncollected OC,[/u] will be returned to the Present Box. OC from sales in the decimal points will be rounded down.
　The deadline for receiving items will be [u]30 days after logging in after maintenance[/u], so please receive the items before then.
　※This update content has been delayed feom the 7/25/2024 update.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[b] 【IMPORTANT】[/b]
・Fixed the incorrect number of [Torn Piece of SP Gacha Ticket] for silver lineup bonus in the shopping plaza's [Angel Nyankoropon].
   Correct Number: 5
   Incorrcet Number:3
   For players who obtained the incorrect number of [Torn Piece of SP Gacha Ticket] from the affected Nyakoropon during the pick up period, we will send the missing pieces to gift box during maintenance.
※ The [Torn Piece of SP Gacha Ticket] will be removed during the maintenance on Thursday, 8/22/2024 JST.

・Fixed an issue in the current [That Which is Precious] event where the entry determination when entering the [Ryusen Beach] portal in Onigashima field was not as intended.

・When the client language is set to [Japanese], fixed an issue where Lucifer's dialogue would not appear when trading at the item exchange in the [Morning Star Rises] event.

・Changes the character voices that plays on the game start to play one randomly.

・The quest intro text of the current [Morning Star Rises] event has been edited.

・An issue where the Okada Izo monster card would not count the boss of the dungeon [Operation Destruction Prevention] has been fixed.


[hr][/hr]
[h2]Others[/h2]
・In the past Dullahan Purgatorium dungeon, the Hard Difficulty clear reward was not the [Headless Warrior Magatama - Lost] as intended but the [Cursect Magatama - Larva] instead. The bug occurred during the two previous event periods, from 7/20~8/3/2023 and 7/11~ 7/25/2024 JST.
　To compensate for this bug, we will send the  [Headless Warrior Magatama - Lost]  to anyone who obtained the [Cursect Magatama - Larva]  as a clear reward during the relevant periods as above. Please note that the [Cursect Magatama - Larva]  will not be collected.
　We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this has caused.
　【addendum】
　※The compensation item [Headless Warrior Magatama - Lost] will be sent as a lucky box.


[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention!
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

notes.title: Ace Support Campaign Begins!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

Beginning after the 7/25/2024 JST maintenance, we will be implementing an
[b]Ace Support Campaign[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1bf83790d26f1e21cbb000fa48fd483e47b22ac0.jpg[/img]

Login during the campaign period to receive a [b]Special Present[/b], 
limited accessories from the [b]Special Login Bonus Calendar[/b], 
and various other boost like the [b]Beginner Boost CP[/b]!
It's not to be missed!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Limited Accessory Login Present![/h3]
All players can login during the event period to receive an [b]Exclusive Accessory[/b] as a special gift!

[b]■Present Items[/b]
・Mysterious Ninjutsu Manual 　x1
・Nyankoropon Ticket　x10
・Full Energy Restorative　x3
・EXP Boost +300% (60Min.)　x3
・Ryou Boost +300% (60Min.)　x3
・Drop Boost +300% (60Min.)　x3

▼Mysterious Ninjutsu Manual 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/9a3f48477419a282e9eee7e983e227ad46451391.jpg[/img]

This accessory provides a bonus to players between level 100 and 119.
It's exclusive to this event, so don't miss the chance to get it!

[b]◆Campaign Period[/b]
　From after maintenance on 7/25/2024 JST
　Until 14:00 on 9/19/2024

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Ace Support Login Bonus Campaign Begins![/h3]

During the event period, players will be able to receive [b]Onigiri Coins[/b] and [b]Exclusive Accessories[/b] as well as other great items from the [b]Ace Support Login Calendar[/b] based on the number of days they log in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4c4f601e992dce8aa31e96e66dc666827f2e50d7.jpg[/img]

It's exclusive to this event, so don't miss the chance to get it!

[b]◆Campaign Period[/b]

　Until 13:59 on 9/19/2024 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Beginner Boost Campaign Begins![/h3]

During the event period, the typical +100% EXP boost for players from level 1-99 
will be extended to players [b] from level 1 ~ 119 and will be EXP +300%[/b]!
There's no better time to level up!

[b]◆Campaign Period[/b]
　After maintenance on 7/25/2024 JST
　Until maintenance on 9/19/2024 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・EXP Ticket Search Dungeon Boost![/h3]

During the campaign period, the EXP Ticket Search dungeons (Normal, Hard, Hell) will have a
[b]reduced stamina cost[/b], as well as a [b]monster drop item +100%[/b] effect added!

※Lucky Box, Partner Items, and Clear Rewards 
　are not affected by the boosted drop rate.

[b]◆Campaign Period[/b]
　After maintenance on 7/25/2024 JST
　Until maintenance on 9/19/2024 JST

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention.
We appreciate your support for Onigiri!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4aedc14c62d2a36b884f4a2fd43cbadfa46aefbf.jpg[/img]

During the event period,  Assault! Dullahan Purgatorium, has been added to the purgatorium dungeons!
Players can obtain not only the regular rewards, but also Purgatorium Treasures from this challenge!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

[b]■About Items from the Dullahan Purgatorium dungeon[/b]
　・The Dullahan Purgatorium Boss will drop the following items:

　　　Normal Difficulty → Headless Warrior's Handguard
　　　Hard Difficulty → Headless Warrior's Horn
　　　Hell Difficulty → Headless Warrior's Arm

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasures[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/495c6fe68b99105847b590f2b7b520aa6d20a31a.jpg[/img]

Look forward to many other items as well!

There will also be a furniture achievement available for players who clear the Hell difficulty multiple times.

[b]■Unlocking Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
Plater must clear the [To Kishinden] quest and speak to the NPC  
Chifuri in the Temporal Rift in order to open these dungeons.

notes.title: New Character Tabu Yaksha Miroku Added!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

It's our pleasure to introduce the skill of the newly added vanguard character, 
[b]Tabu Yaksha Miroku[/b], added on 6/27/2024 JST!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2cb9e67a4c122eb590afa9e92f9d69405eb66290.png[/img]
VA：Motoshi Kuwahara

The new vanguard [b]Tabu Yaksha Miroku[/b] can be unlocked 
by using the Summoner's Scroll Tabu Yaksha Miroku item.
He will battle by your side, but with a [b]Vanguard Swap [/b] you can take control of him!

Using spears as his weapon of choice, Tabu Yaksha Miroku takes advantage of the wind and physical strength to attack enemies with agile dexterity!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the Skill Focus Movement System[/h3]

Tabu Yaksha Miroku is equipped with a novel [b]Skill Focus Movement System[/b] which when a skill is activated [b]the focus in the skill slot will automatically move to the slot below[/b]
※If the Focus Skill is on the 5th slot, after movement the new Focused Skill will be the 1st slot.

This function allows for seamless Skill activation.
Combine various skills in unique combinations to unleash powerful combo attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/452bfbda448e32a22700ce38ee0739ef0bd52821.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]
[h3]Critical Power Limit Increase[/h3]

During the Vanguard Swap, Tabu Yaksha Miroku will always activate [b]critical power limit up buff, Assassin's Secrets[/b] .
In the instance your critical force is not sufficient,  the skill [Return Yaksha] can also be used, [b]which grants the One-Hit Kill buff that temporarily increases critical force[/b].
※One-Hit Kill is consumed when a critical hit occurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/44afef17335f436bc2052e684f1e0264c35e440c.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Partner Summoning Support[/h3]

Tabu Yaksha Miroku will always cast [Assasin's Secrets] on the player character when summoned, but also strengthens the player's Critical Hit power using [One-Hit Kill] during battle.
Take him with you in combat to experience an exhilarating fast paced and lethal fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a416c8f50b4632d5fb05fdad7931827e96a35cf0.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Intro[/h3]
Some of Tabu Yaksha Miroku's Skills will be showcased below.
※Some skills may require an increase in Partner Level and Awakening to be used.

[b]■Sanguine Tabu - Cloud Crush[/b]
Tabu Yaksha Miroku teleports above the enemy's head and swing the spear down with force.
A useful skill for closing the distance between you and your foes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0f8d62b75a6abdfdcd6f073c27830e7584cbdebf.png[/img]


[b]■Sanguine Tabu - Piercing Storm[/b]
Tabu Yaksha Miroku attacks the opponent with fired bullets of condensed wind.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/cd74d5351b5b50ffddc78224a38f4eb7211bf1ee.png[/img]


[b]■Sanguine Tabu - Return Yaksha[/b]
Tabu Yaksha Miroku having the blood of the past boils up within, causing a berserk state.
For 5 seconds, SP recovers, the cooldown reduction rate increases, and HP recovers  on critical hits. Additionally, a stack of 10 One-Hit Kill buffs will be imparted, which increases the power of critical hits.
※1 [One-Hit Kill] will be consumed on a critical hit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/117f5e0f957daf1bc3dd3dae24315846078b1916.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Sanguine Tabu - Flash of Annihilation[/b]
Tabu Yaksha Miroku teleports into the prey's vicinity and sweeps away everything nearby with a blinding stroke.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ee95c151db8f50614fd85a70fefe80f46828bfe9.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Sanguine Tabu - Rush of Killing Wind[/b]
A charged technique in which Tabu Yaksha Miroku releases the spear to savagely tear into the opponent with sharp claws.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2159524886e71083bb89868c92062586884a0955.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]
Dance across the battlefield with [b]Tabu Yaksa Miroku[/b] and lay waste to your enemies with agile fury!

※Images are created during development and are subject to change.
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your attention!
We appreciate your support for Onigiri!

notes.title: Announcement of the Beta Release of the 32-bit Version of Onigiri
notes.content:
Greeting from Onigiri Management Team.

During the maintenance on Thursday, 5/30/2024 JST, we transitioned the Steam version of  "Onigiri" to a 64-bit client. However, we have encountered an issue where the game does not launch when the "Play" button is pressed in the Steam client.
As a temporary measure to address this issue,[b]we have released a 32-bit beta version of  "Onigiri"[/b]。

If the issue is not resolved even after trying the solutions provided in the notice below, please switch to the 32-bit beta version of "Onigiri" and try launching the game.

Regarding the issue where the game client does not start:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/290470/view/4181108468552220236

[hr][/hr]
[h3]■How to switch to 32-bit beta version[/h3]
①Right-click on "Onigiri" in Steam library to open the "Properties" screen.

②"Betas" → Select "32bit - onigiri 32bit" from the "Beta Participation" dropdown options to download 32-bit beta version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4468db5f29fe198e5d98781db964c2fb8471cf3f.png[/img]

※Select "None" from the "Beta Participation" dropdown options to revert your game to the 64-bit version.
※Bith the 32-bit and 64-bit versions use the same game database. There are no differences in game progress or obtained items.

[hr][/hr]
If the issue persists even after trying the above solutions, please report it via the inquiry form on the Onigiri's Steam official website.

Onigiri's Steam official website
https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/


We are going to continue to investigate this issue to ensure that more users can play the 64-bit version.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 5/9/2024 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Update Information[/h2]
[h3]・A Stamina Restoration Panel will be added.[/h3]
　A button will be added next to the energy display in normal screens and dungeon panels, etc., which will display the Stamina restoration panel.
　It will not be displayed within dungeons, and only upon attempting to enter a dungeon through a portal when stamina amount is insufficient.

　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b479970acdd92b648edd05052126ffaa27af4aa8.png[/img]

　The Stamina Restoration panel will display the stamina recovery potions available in your inventory. (Items in storage will have a storage icon on the bottom right of the item)
　Multiple Stamina Restoration potions can be used simultaneously by entering the number of items desired and pressing the [Use] button.
　Stamina can be recovered with Onigiri Coins by selecting the [Recover with Onigiri Coins] icon on the bottom left of the panel.

　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/208452a584f2bbc808b99668021af17f15749dc2.png[/img]

　Along with the addition of the Stamina Restoration Panel, the following items will be changed/adjusted.
　●Maximum Stamina Restoration amount will be 500.
　●If Stamina is insufficient when entering a dungeon, the Stamina Restoration panel will be displayed.
　●When entering a dungeon, Stamina will be checked before agreeing to the points of caution.
　●The location of Stamina on the Dungeon Panel will be changed.
　●If Stamina exceeds the natural recovery limit, the recovery time will not be displayed.
　●The UI for Stamina and Recovery Time will be edited.
　●The UI for Aramitama Stamina will be edited.

[hr][/hr]
・The following changes will be made to the Partner Character Gift panel.
　●The display order of items has been changed.
　●Items in Storage will be denoted with a mark on their icons.

・An image will be added to the Storage switch button in Shizuka Gozen's Storage.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
・A bug that prevents multi-locking under certain conditions for the skill [Divination Frozen Rat] of Vanguard Swap character [Abe no Seimei].

・When the language setting was set to English or Traditional Chinese, the link destination of the [ Welcome and Comeback Campaign] information banner will be corrected .

[addendum]
[u]・When the language setting was set to English, fixed a bug in which the end date and time of [Sakura MyRoom Nyankoropon] was incorrect.[/u]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Ending Events[/h2]
・The following dungeons will end.
　Dragon Ark Tenshou - Purgatorium
　Dragon Ark Gakuhou - Purgatorium
　Dragon Ark Aosame - Purgatorium
　Please look forward to their eventual return.
　At this time Purgatorium Treasures will be converted to Purgatorium Junk.

・The following Nyankoropon will be removed.
　Partner Accessory Nyankoropon
　Sublime Ougi Nyankoropon
　Super Magatama Nyankoropon
　Partner Accessory Limited Nyankoropon
　Sublime Ougi Limited Nyankoropon
　Super Magatama Limited Nyankoropon

・The Shopping Plaza Sale will end.

・The Dungeon Boost Campaign will end.
　Reduced Stamina costs and boosted drop rates will return to normal.

・The Point Daruma Exchange Bonus will end.


[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention!

※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

During the event period, Assault! Sleetsword Gargoyle, has been added to the purgatorium dungeons!
Players can obtain not only the regular rewards, but also Purgatorium Treasures from this challenge!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

[b]■About Items from the Levinlance Gargoyle Purgatorium dungeon[/b]
　・The Levinlance Gargoyle Purgatorium Boss will drop the following items:

　　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Fang
　　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Hand
　　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Nucleus

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasures[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

Plater must clear the [To Kishinden] quest and speak to the NPC Chifuri in the Temporal Rift in order to open these dungeons.

notes.title: [COMPLETE] 1/26 Temporary Maintenance
notes.content:
"Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The maintenance which began at 10:00 pm on 1/25/2024 has ended as of 0:30 am.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

・An issue where some of the [Dancing on thre Wings of Cosmic Balance] Event achievements was incorrect has been fixed.
　Previously：Temporal Rift Interception (Abe no Seimei)
　Corrected：Temporal Rift Circle of Yang (Abe no Seimei)
　※Acheivement number will not be reset as a result of this correction.

・In the [Dancing on the Wings of Cosmic Balance] 2nd half event dungeon [Temporal Rift Circle of Yang], a bug where the boss monster would sometimes disappear unintentinally will be fixed.

・An issue where the item stock numbers for the current [Wings of Cosmic Balance] 2nd half event are incorrectly linked to the previous half on the event for the following items:
　Cursed Blood
　Flickering Fish
　The fix for this issue will also reset the stock available for the 1st half of the event.

・An issue where the New Year Gift Nyankoropon Ticket is still included in the lineup of the current [Dancing on the Wings of Cosmic Balance] 2nd Half event despite the fact it cannot be used has been confirmed
　To address this issue we will change the status of this exchange item to a sold-out status.

----------------------------------------------------------------

As a compensation for the emergency maintenance and the errors, the followin items will be sent.

■Compensation Items
　・Full Energy Restorative　x3
　・Daily Event Completion Reward for 2 Day

◆Target Accounts
　Accounts existing as of 15:00 on 1/24/2024 JST

◆Item Validity
　Until 14:00 on 2/23/2024 JST

※Items will be delivered to an account's present box.
　Gifts can be received by navigating to the [Menu] → [System] → [Present] screens.
※Item can only be recieved by one character per account, so please select the correct character.
※Compensation items will not be destributed on a specific schedule.


Thank you for your attention.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
Thank you for supporting Onigiri!"

During the event period, Assault! Levinlance Gargoyle, has been added to the purgatorium dungeons!

notes.title: New Character [Abe no Seimei] Added!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

On New Years Day 2024, the new character
[b]Abe no Seimei[/b] will be released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/37c9ec2a16cba969335f0321597453510647caee.png[/img]

VA：Manaka Iwami

The new character [b]Abe no Seimei[/b] can be 
unlocked with the [b]Summoner's Scroll - Abe no Seimei[/b] item.
Not only will he fight alongside you, he can be controlled with the [b]Vanguard Swap[/b] function.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the [Twelve Generals] System[/h3]

Abe no Seimei utilizes the [b][Twelve Generals] system[/b],  and the frame with automatically selected masks is displayed will be displayed on the right hand side during a Vanguard Swap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b5b41cd379b1ac0528cdaf6765ffe2ee67fdbc3f.png[/img]

Abe no Seimei possesses 12 masks, choose from between 5 masks automatically selected to set the [b]corresponding skills in the skill slot[/b].
This allows Seimei to utilize 9 different attack skills and 2 support skills to manipulate various atributes.
Moreover, there is 1 special mask whose skill is not set in the slot.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]How to Use the 12 Generals System[/h3]

When performing a vanguard change, 5 masks will be selected from the 12 masks and placed into a frame.

Select a mask by pressing the guard button + directional input, and use the Ougi skills set in the Ougi slots in order to [b]set the mask's skill to the skill slot or redraw the mask[/b].
※Abe no Seimei cannot [Guard].

[b]■Ougi  Divination Knot[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/f704184f9a601f0c849ca736b13e6d60ff15b8df.png[/img]

Set the selected mask skill to the skill slot.
The slot to be set is predetermined for each mask, and if a mask has the same skill slot as a prior mask the skill will be overwritten.

[b]Skill Slots and Corresponding Masks[/b]
Skill Slot ①
Divination Blazing Horse (Fire Attribute, Horse Mask)
Divination Drenched Boar (Rain Attribute, Boar Mask)
Divination Fickle Tiger (Wind Attribute, Tiger Mask)
Divination Thunderous Monkey (Lightning Attribute, Monkey Mask)

Skill Slot ②
Divination Crag Wolf (Mountain Attribute, Dog Mask)
Divination Frozen Rat (Ice Attribute, Rat Mask)
Divination Golden Dragon (Holy Attribute, Dragon Mask)
Divination Gloomy Ram (Dark Attribute, Ram Mask)

Skill Slot ③
Divination Snake Strangle (Buff Skill, Snake Mask)
Divination Phoenix Standard (Buff Skill, Rooster Mask)
Divination Empty Rabbit (Non elemental, Rabbit Mask)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/df97951a6272ca9b3f520e3f9b3a72fac1fca519.png[/img]

Masks' corresponding skill slots can be determined by looking at the icons displayed to the right of each skill slot.
※The selected mask icon will be highlighted.


[b]■ Ougi Divination Wisdom[/b]
Return the selected mask to draw another.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Mask Return and Replacement[/h3]

In order to set a mask skill, you need to consume a certain number of masks from your hand. 
If the number of masks in your hand is less than the required number, you will not be able to set the skill.

The number of masks consumed varies depending on mask type and level,  and in addition to the selected mask, the number of masks required to set the skill will be randomly consumed from your hand.

Empty slots can be refilled by [b]attacking enemies and using skills[/b].

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Mask Level[/h3]

By setting a mask skill over a skill that has already been set, the mask level will increase by 1 and the power and effect of the skill will become stronger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8d43809b48cd4ea0dd9fbd97a70e6c0ce01eff23.png[/img]

The number displayed to the bottom right of the mask frame is the mask level.
The maximum level for each mask is 3, and setting the same mask's skill when its level is already max will have no effect and the mask will be discarded.

Once mask level has been increased it will not be reset unless one of the the following conditions is met:
・You leave the dungeon
・Seimei's HP reaches 0 during a Vanguard Swap
・Seimei is withdrawn

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the Ox Mask[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/91c5336875d2065cf109dd26ca41dda36a1e6ee6.png[/img]

The Ox Mask's [Imperial Formation] special skill cannot be set to a skill slot.
Setting the Ox Mas will use the skill automatically,  [b]randomly increasing the level of other mask skills set by 1[/b].

If the level of all set skills' corresponding masks is maximum, [Imperial Formation]  will not be activated and the mask will remain in your hand.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Showcase[/h3]

A portion of Seimei's skills will be introduced below.
[b]※Abe no Seimei can use all of his skills once he is obtained.[/b]

[b]■Divination Blazing Horse ( Horse Mask)[/b]
Deploys shikigami that march forward, wreathed in flames. Causes burns with a set probability.
A quick skill that is easy to use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1c48e97a6887bf147e7142a6fa125c03549ee5f6.png[/img]

[b]■Divination Gloomy Ram (Ram Mask)[/b]
Summons a dark swamp to the fore, dealing damage to anyone who steps into it.
Adds slow debuff with a set probability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/f01d8e7f5b69cced9db64c67c14e7c43df65858a.png[/img]

[b]■Divination Empty Rabbit (Rabbit Mask)[/b]
Creates a void and shoots it forward, dealing fixed damage to the opponent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b8e5c9ec229f80abefdf86ee42159a46791678c9.png[/img]

[b]Divination Snake Strangle (Snake Mask)[/b]
A powerful buff skill that increases critical rate, critical power, and raises the damage limit.

tags.feature:
The new character [b]Abe no Seimei[/b] can be 
unlocked with the [b]Summoner's Scroll - Abe no Seimei[/b] item.
Abe no Seimei utilizes the [b][Twelve Generals] system[/b],  and the frame with automatically selected masks is displayed will be displayed on the right hand side during a Vanguard Swap.
Abe no Seimei possesses 12 masks, choose from between 5 masks automatically selected to set the [b]corresponding skills in the skill slot[/b].
Select a mask by pressing the guard button + directional input, and use the Ougi skills set in the Ougi slots in order to [b]set the mask's skill to the skill slot or redraw the mask[/b].
Set the selected mask skill to the skill slot.
Return the selected mask to draw another.
Empty slots can be refilled by [b]attacking enemies and using skills[/b].
By setting a mask skill over a skill that has already been set, the mask level will increase by 1 and the power and effect of the skill will become stronger.
The Ox Mask's [Imperial Formation] special skill cannot be set to a skill slot.
Setting the Ox Mas will use the skill automatically,  [b]randomly increasing the level of other mask skills set by 1[/b].
A portion of Seimei's skills will be introduced below.
Deploys shikigami that march forward, wreathed in flames. Causes burns with a set probability.
Summons a dark swamp to the fore, dealing damage to anyone who steps into it.
Creates a void and shoots it forward, dealing fixed damage to the opponent.
A powerful buff skill that increases critical rate, critical power, and raises the damage limit.

notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2b6dc50833cd77b69723b24ba56b82ae403ec1b2.png[/img]

The Reclining Character furniture series will cost 25 OC each and are limited to one purchase each.

[b]■Added Furniture[/b]
　Reclining Amanojaku

[b]◆Furniture Availability[/b]
　After maintenance 12/7/2023 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Purgatorium Dungeon Added![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1e40cee776c0543c0c0c9febc22f1e56a5a7f16a.jpg[/img]

During the event period, Assault! Infernal Gargoyle, has been added to the purgatorium dungeons!
Players can obtain not only the regular rewards, but also Purgatorium Treasures from this challenge!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

[b]■About Items from the Infernal Gargoyle Purgatorium dungeon[/b]
　・The Infernal Gargoyle Purgatorium Boss will drop the following items:

　　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Infernal Gargoyle's Fang
　　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Infernal Gargoyle's Hand
　　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Infernal Gargoyle's Nucleus

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasures[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[b]▼Exchange Item Sample[/b]
[table]
[tr][td][b]Type[/b][/td][td][b]Item[/b][/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Weapon Recipe[/td][td]Flamejaw Gibbet Recipe[/td][/tr]

[tr][td]Weapon Recipe[/td][td]Flamejaw Gibbet - Nova Recipe[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Weapon Recipe[/td][td]Flamejaw Gibbet - Void Recipe[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Magatama[/td][td]Hell Flame Magatama[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Manifestation Scroll[/td][td]Flamejaw Gibbet Manifestation Scroll[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Manifestation Scroll[/td][td]Flamejaw Gibbet - Flare Manifestation Scroll[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Manifestation Scroll[/td][td]Flamejaw Gibbet - Nova Manifestation Scroll[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/d2fcd7c9a2d5bee40950cb8e373d19c15429c267.png[/img]

[b]■Unlocking Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
Plater must clear the [To Kishinden] quest and speak to the NPC Chifuri in the Temporal Rift in order to open these dungeons.

[b]◆Dungeon Availability[/b]
　After maintenance 12/7/2023 JST
　Until maintenance 12/21/2023 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・[Oni in Onigashima] Event Begins! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/5121c19cfeaf480862f02021375a11a70ce18d53.jpg[/img]

The Setsubun event returns to Onigashima!

[b]~Synopsis~[/b]
Izuna took her eyes off the beans for the Setsubun festival for just a moment and they vanished...
Can you help her find where they've gone?

During the event period, talk to [b]Kitsune Girl Izuna[/b] in Onigashima to undertake the event quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1c6d6aa6e7b80f005dd9992e66cd4bda6a65fb30.png[/img]

[b]※The Main Story Quest [To Kishinden] must be cleared to accept this event quest.[/b]

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆About the Event Dungeon◆[/b]
In the event dungeon, abilities other than weapons are fixed, and an HP and SP recovery effect will be enabled.
The dungeon also has an Oni mode available.
For details, please check with the Setsubun Guide NPC in front of the Onigashima Training Grounds.

[b]◆About the Event Bonus◆[/b]
Event items can be obtained as drop rewards and dungeon clear rewards from monsters in each event dungeon.
Also, if you meet certain conditions, you can get more event items when you clear the dungeon!

[b]■Bonus Characters[/b]
　Amanojaku, Izuna, Izuna Tri-Tails, Izuna Five-Tails, Kintoki, Oda Nobunaga

※Select the Bonus button on the dungeon panel to confirm bonus details.
※Please be sure to use Summoning Scrolls prior to entering a Dungeon in order to be eligible for the Bonus.
※Please clear the dungeon with the target accessories equipped.

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆About the Vanguard Amanojaku◆[/b]
Players can obtain the summoning scroll for [b]Amanojaku[/b] as a quest reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/01fe13adfb314c0184a76384d4fd17236d6e78b6.png[/img]
・Quest Clear Reward x1
・Event Exchange x10
・Dungeon Clear Reward
　Dungeons：Onigashima Training Grounds - Setsubun (Oni Difficulty), Kishinden - Setsubun (Oni Difficulty), Wayward Shrine (All difficulties)

----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]◆Event Rewards◆[/b]
Clear the event quest to unlock Namahage's event exchange.

[b]■Exchange Lineup Sample[/b]
[table][tr][td]Reward[/td][td]Type[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Summoner's Scroll[/td][td]Amanojaku[/td][/tr]

[/table] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/26067df42db2d6254495f1068872e002bec2ffdd.png[/img]

[b]◆Event Period[/b]
　After maintenance 12/7/2023 JST
　Until maintenance 2/22/2024 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・2nd Storage Expansion Implemented![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3dec08ce088cad3c57208557691c76708ad114a0.jpg[/img]

A [b]Second Storage [/b] will be added to Lady Shizuka's storage!

[b]■About the Second Storage[/b]
With this update, a storage toggle button will be added to the top of the storage UI.
The previously existing Storage will be renamed First Storage in contrast to the Second Storage, and a button to toggle to it will be added to the UI.
Miroku's [Sell] function will also feature a toggle to the 2nd Storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/cfc6e76a79f4868353e6bdbcba9fda7e4cf92be7.png[/img]

In order to open and expand the 2nd Storage, the following items will be required.

[b]●2nd Storage Unlock[/b]
Use the 2nd Storage Unlock item to open Lady Shizuka's 2nd Storage.
The initial item capacity is 150 (+ Resonance), but the number can be
increased by purchasing 2nd Storage Expansion items.
Max inventory will be 650 including any Resonance.
Price：150 Paid OC
※ After the present period ends, item will be added to the Shopping Plaza.

[b]●2nd Storage Expansion[/b]
Purchase a 2nd Storage expansion item to increase 2nd Storage item max by 50 slots.
Up to 7 Storage Expansion items can be purchased from the Shopping Plaza.
Price：100 OC

[b]Limited Time 2nd Storage Expansion Present![/b]
For a limited time, we will be giving 2nd Storage expansion as a free gift!
One expansion per account will be sent to the Present Box, so please receive it with your favorite character ♪

[b]◆Present Period[/b]
　After maintenance 12/7/2023 JST
　Until maintenance 1/25/2024 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・Story Playback Function Added![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/5ce02bdf86aaafce5ba7fcdacddcc9ba0fe001ca.jpg[/img]

Previously cleared quests and in-game movies can now be viewed with the newly added 
[b]Playback[/b] Function!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/58296189dfeb000aa1cbfe89895608335c530e41.png[/img]

[b]■How to Use[/b]
The Playback Function can be accessed from the [Menu] → [Story] → [Playback] navigation.
After selecting the title of the sequence you want to watch, select [Play] to play the sequence.

[b]■About Playback Items[/b]
Cleared story sequences that can be viewed in Playback will be displayed in a list.
The sequence title is likely to share the same name as the associated quest, but may receive additional modifiers.（Example：Prologue: To the Onigashima Training Grounds, etc.) 

Currently viewable quests are those from the start of the game until [To Kishinden].
We hope to include more quests for your viewing pleasure soon!

[hr][/hr]

・At the portal to the Thanksgiving venue in Onigashima field, you will be able to select the event dungeon from the portal if you have cleared the [Maid/Butler Training] event quest.

　This item will be deleted during the next maintenance, and playerswho have received the reward for the corresponding achievement by that maintenance will be issued the correct reward item.

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1a48664a27f9a676fe890e5f932bcfede117b250.jpg[/img]

During the event period,  Assault! Dragon Ark Aosame, has been added to the purgatorium dungeons!
Players can obtain not only the regular rewards, but also Purgatorium Treasures from this challenge!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

[b]■About Items from the Dragon Ark Aosame Purgatorium dungeon[/b]

　　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Uryuu's Fittings
　　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Uryuu's Amethyst

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasures[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

notes.title: New Character Izuna Five-Tails Added!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

Some skills from the new vanguard implemented on 10/26/2023 JST, 
[b]Izuna Five-Tails[/b], will be showcased below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a95cdd48f6529ae123e888f6f09637d65dcdb25a.png[/img]

VA：Terashima Miyu

The vanguard [b]Izuna Five-Tails[/b] can be added to the roster  
by using the [b]Summoner's Scroll - Izuna Five-Tails [/b]item.
In addition to fighting alongside the players, Izuna Five-Tails can be controlled with a [b]Vanguard Swap[/b]!

Fighting primarily with a bow, Izuna Five-Tails can also control her shikigami Sakon and Ukon to fire Aura bullets.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the Shikigami and [Resolute][/h3]

Izuna Five Tails shikigami can make use of the Resolutes skill, which regularly allows Izuna to survive a single fatal hit, but [b]empowers her shikigami based on the number of Resolutes buffs they have[/b].
If the player has one Resolutes effect, Ukon will be strengthened, if two or more are active, Sakon will be strenghtened, and depending on which shikigami has been strengthened, [b]specific skill effects or attack power will be increased[/b].

Izuna Five-Tails [b]automatically receive two Resolutes buffs[/b]on a Vanguard Swap, so both shikigami can be strengthened immediately after a Vanguard Swap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/995e58ae669a9cde25faeac04527646ebd6813c6.png[/img]

Izuna also possesses skills which consume all of the shikigami's buffs to deal attacks with increased damage!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Basic Combos[/h3]

Basic combo attacks will restore HP and SP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4dfce0a47a0acc81c88b40ccd5ad1938e1dfb8ee.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Perfect Guard[/h3]

[b]While the shikigami are in a strengthened state[/b], a properly executed Perfect Guard [b]Ukon will recover HP and Sakon will fire Aura bullets in a counter attack[/b].


[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Introduction[/h3]
Some of Izuna Five-Tails' skills will be introduced below.
※Skill acquisition is based on Partner level and Awakening.

[b]■Fox Curse Halting Finger[/b]
A special technique Izuna learned when she only had three tails. Materializes swords to rain down on a sinle locked-on enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e050175b445ad9563c938a1887bf1cc2008d8e03.png[/img]


[b]■Fox Curse Ukon Insignia[/b]
Ukon's blessing greatly recovers one character's HP and removes abnormal; status effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/eb9742675280052deb7c303a242ce28f5cca6340.png[/img]


[b]■Fox Curse Seal Release[/b]
Temporarily releases the safety seal on her magics, allowing a dramatic increase in power.
Attack, defense, and damage limit will increase, and damage will be incurred when touching the revolving shikigami. The effect changes depending on the shikigami's strengthened state.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b2c1127a5f2e7c8d9453dfdc242bd0b5b475a6d9.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Fox Curse Destruction Mandala[/b]
Sakon and Ukon fire twin beams of destructive light. The effect changes depending on the shikigami's strengthened state.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b1b9a6c470ae5bc9f1f68b326db3ec6b72c56d88.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Fox Curse Tail Spirit Light[/b]
A skill that combines the powers of the separated shikigami, consuming their Resolutes in order to unleash great power.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8019c546484c1b080d6b50003b3681d1f146f837.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Get ready to meet a strengthened, [b]grown up Izuna[/b], just waiting to join you!

※Images are taken during development and are subjct to change.
※Update details may change without notice.

Thank you for your attention.
We appreciate your support of Onigiri!

notes.title: About the new Fulmination Magatama and Ornamentation
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team. As of the 10/5/2023 JST Update, the new Polished Brass and Polished Peony Wood will be added. These items will be added to the Point Daruma exchange, will be limited to a stock of 2 which refreshes each month. They will also be avaialble from the Nyankoropon beginning 10/5. ※These items cannot be sold in player stalls. [hr][/hr] [h2]Concerning the new Magatama[/h2] The following Magatama will be available in the Gold Tier Nyankoropon. 　Fulmination Magatama - Sword 　Fulmination Magatama - Oodachi 　Fulmination Magatama - Axe 　Fulmination Magatama - Spear 　Fulmination Magatama - Twin Swords 　Fulmination Magatama - Bow 　Fulmination Magatama - Wand 　Fulmination Magatama - Staff The Fulmination Magatama requires less chakra to use, strengthens the Lightning Element, and [b]grants a buff that raises the upper damage limit[/b]. These Magatama are available from the Nyankoropon in a set with the new materials Polished Brass and Polished Peony Wood. Also, by dismantling the magatama, you can get one of the materials that was in the set. [hr][/hr] [h2Concerning new Magatama Crafting[/h2] Kaguya will be able to make more of the Blaze Magatama by using one of the new materials as well. 　Fulmination Magatama Mod - Sword 　Fulmination Magatama Mod - Oodachi 　Fulmination Magatama Mod - Axe 　Fulmination Magatama Mod - Spear 　Fulmination Magatama Mod - Twin Blade 　Fulmination Magatama Mod - Bow 　Fulmination Magatama Mod - Wand 　Fulmination Magatama Mod - Staff Both Magatama varieties impart the power buff. The availability of the Fulmination Mod Magatama depends on the level of Kaguya's crafting ability. ※These Magatama cannot be sold in stalls.
[hr][/hr] [h2]About the New Magatama Ornamentation[/h2] New Magatama Ornamentations made from Polished Brass and Polished Peony Wood will be added. These new Ornamentations will be available dependent on the Ornamentation level of the player's Kaguya. These ornamentations will bestow certain effects certainly, and other effects with a given probability. Some of the ornamentations available as of 10/5/2023 JST are as follows.
[b]Angel of Temperance - III[/b](Characteristics: All traits Required Purity: 11 Chakra: +8) 　Required Materials：Polished Brass x10, Polished Peony Wood x10 　・MND +6~9 　・SP Consumption Rate reduction +15~25 　・Weapon Durability Reduction chance 15~25% less likely 　・Cooldown Time reduction rate +7~10 [b]Burning Red Star - III[/b](Characteristics: All traits Required Purity: 11 Chakra: +8) 　Required Materials：Polished Brass x10, Polished Peony Wood x10 　・Attack Power +5%~8% 　・Attack Speed +5~8 　・Difficulty 5 or higher skill lvl +25%~35% 　・One of the following: 　　●Slice Element +25~35 　　●Impact Element +25~35 　　●Pierce Element +25~35 ※Magatama will not be destroyed when Ornamentation fails for additional attributes.
[hr][/hr] Thank you for your attention. We appreciate your support for Onigiri!

notes.title: [Addendum]9/14/2023 Update Information
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a19a3f504b564c12ab666d4f4106c55baf47bb0b.jpg[/img]

[Addendum 9/14]
-Added note regarding the problem that prevented logging in after the maintenance on 8/24/2024.
-Corrected and added wording regarding adjustments to the item [Mysterious Metal Fragment] regarding a drop rate bug.


Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 9/14/2023 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Update Information[/h2]
・The status effects Poison and Burn will no longer cause damage when HP falls to 0, but will cause damage if HP is at 1.
　In accordance with this change, Sesshu's main combo attack [Blood Bloom] and [Warbrush Ougi: Withered Bamboo] will confer damage in the same fashion.

・The following changes will be made to the descriptions of [Bonus Damage] and [Critical Bonus Damage] in buff and weapon options to make them easier to understand.
　Upper damage limit will also be listed.
　　Bonus Damage Example)
　　Before Change：A bonus of 1 damage is dealt depending on the value of Fire Element during a critical hit, at a rate of 50%. ※Damage cap cannot be exceeded
　　After Change：50% chance of adding 100% of damage dealt as Fire Element damage ※Damage Limit 1,000,000
　　Critical Bonus Damage Example)
　　Before Change：Deals 1 additional damage on critical hit according to Fire Element values *Limit to Damage Added
　　After Change：On critical hit, 100% of the damage dealt is added to total damage as Fire Element ※Damage Limit 1,000,000
　In accordance with this change, Sesshu's Skill Warbrush Ougi: Inner Paradise will have the text description edited.

・For Sesshu, special effects will now be added to damage for [Blood Bloom] and [Warbrush Ougi: Withered Bamboo].

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
・Corrects an issue where the upper damage limit for Sesshu's skill [Warbrush Ougi: Inner Paradise] was not as intended.
　Before edit：Max 1,000,000
　After edit：Max 5,000,000

・Fixed an issue where Sesshu's vanguard replacement gauge increase amount was incorrect at Awakening LV5.
　Before Change：Vanguard Gauge Increase＋200％
　After Change：Vanguard Gauge Increase＋400％

・Fixed an issue where the Sake would disappear when the Sesshu's vanguard swap was cancelled.

・Corrected an issue where Sesshu would visually dissapear when the Ink Gauge ran low while the skill [Warbrush: Petals] was active.

・Fixed an issue where the dungeon portal for [the Treasure Hunt! Battle on the Abandoned Island!] event would appear on Onigashima field.

・An issue where players who had refilled their Sake with [Benten's Blessing] or [Moth Orchid] before the 8/24/2023 JST maintenance could not log in has been corrected.
　※Players affected by this issue will have compensation sent at a later date. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
　[u][Addendum][/u]
　[u]We will also investigate the status of the achievement and send compensation items  at a later date.[/u]

・Fixed an issue where Amakusa Shiro's feet clipped through the ground in the [That Which Is Precious] event field [Mountain Forest Depths].

[u][Addendum and Revisions][/u]
・The [That Which Is Precious] Event Dungeon had lower than intended drop rates of the [Mysterious Metal Fragment] on Hard and Hell difficulties.
　[u]To adjust for this, the number of Mysterious Metal Fragments required for the exchange will be changed.[/u]
　[u]※Characters who have already made exchanges requiring the Mysterious Metal Fragments will be compensated the number of fragments making the difference in exchange rate.[/u]
　　[u]Supplementary items will also be sent contingent on the number of dungeon clears. We sincerely apologize for this issue.[/u]
　[u]Additionally, we will be adding [the Unusual Metal Fragment Basket] at the bottom of the exchange, which will  allow players to exchange for the [Strange Metal Fragment] and [Bizarre Metal Fragment] items.[/u]

・For Sesshu, the notation fluctuation of the skill descriptions have been corrected and adjusted to make them easier to read.

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention!
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.

　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

notes.title: New Character Sesshu Added!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

On the 8/24/2023 JST maintenance, the new vanguard
[b]Sesshu[/b] will be added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/337d23b7a4ae464a409c163f8485141f5d012b23.png[/img]

CV：Inuchiyo Kokona

[b]Sesshu[/b] can be added to your Partner Character roster by using the [b]Summoner's Scroll - Sesshu [/b]item.
Players can summon Sesshu to fight alongside them or play as her using a [b]Vanguard Swap[/b]!


[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the Ink Gauge [/h3]

Sesshu possesses a special [b]Ink Gauge [/b]system which will be displayed in the bottom right corner during a Vanguard Swap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/18d56b099c2af1f6693ad8ed13a8acc5f5b50e05.png[/img]

The Ink Gauge will accumulate when using certain skills.
Skills which consume the Ink Gauge will have a marker next to the skill slot.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the Basic Combo[/h3]

Hold the basic combo button to have Sesshu [b]paint the ground with ink while running[/b].
Flowers bloom fromthis ink with various effects that are apparent when players or enemies touch them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/62d5c7f35253c67389f1fe43b4e751cb420178d8.png[/img]

・Blood Bloom：Applies a debuff that continuously damages monsters it touches for 5 seconds. Ink Gauge recovers on damage inflicted.
・Cure Bloom：Applies a buff that restores HP for 5 seconds to the player it touches.
・Spell Bloom：Applies a buff that restores SP for 5 seconds to the player it touches.

Certain skills will increase the power of the basic combo and also manifest flowers with different effects from the ones above.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About the Special Skills[/h3]

Some skills will cause Sesshu to [b]float in the air[/b] allowing Sesshu to paint ink directly on the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/6f4ee09c930e8d94bdcf7ec2ee0c8c0d1bfdd435.png[/img]

Sesshu is invicible while floating in the air, but it consumes a lot of the ink gauge every second it is active, so plan it carefully.

Let's materialize Lotus flower that provides powerful buffs to allies or Bamboos to stall monsters to support the batlle!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Intro[/h3]
A certain portion of the skills will be showcased below.
※Skill acuisition is based on Awakening level and Partner level.


[b]■Warbrush: Revolution[/b]
A simple skill which quickly rotates the brush to attack.
Continually press the activation button to continue spinning until the Ink Gauge runs out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e68393bccd5181efd2806f823e24876dc4d4f2a2.png[/img]


[b]■Warbrush: Petals[/b]
Rises in the air and blooms Guard Bloom that increases the amount of the Vanguard Gauge increase for 10 seconds.
The flowers will remain for a certain period of time after the Vanguard Swap is cancelled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2030e94c1da571ac0080ab79ea7f0d7876be7351.png[/img]


[b]■Warbrush: Bokujuu Reveille[/b]
Bokujuu's spirit sent by Sesshu to make a protective barrier.
Players touching the barrier gain a def buff for 10 seconds and can recover from a fatal attack once.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c25d935ac7893a78cda396a10e8aefb0be1ad15b.png[/img]


[b]■Warbrush Ougi: Rocky Landscape[/b]
Jump back after manifesting a mysteriously powerful rocky mountain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/6435c6b81d1299a4abfa61bc665a4248d0990421.png[/img]


[b]■Warbrush Ougi: Inner Paradise[/b]
Floating in the air, a lotus of paradise blooms from ink on the ground.
For 10 seconds after touching the lotus, attack, crit rate, and SP consumption reduction rate increase, and a powerful buff with a 50% chance of causing additional damage is applied.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/08ce74d58cc5d204c75931359eff474b23a4f6e4.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Let's turn the battlefield into a fabulous painting with the young prodigy [b]Sesshu[/b]!

※Images are taken during development.
※Update contents are subject to change without notice.

Thank you for your attention.
We hope you will enjoy the updates for Onigiri!

notes.content:

Greetings from the Onigiri Management Team.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!
We appreciate all of your responses to the 2023 Onigiri Questionnaire.

We will share select results from the questionnaire with you all below.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]About Events and Updates[/h2]
[h3]Q. Please tell us about events you enjoyed most recently. (Choose up to 2)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/614196ae331df598fe2252cc690a3d3196121a42.png[/img]
1st：2022 Onigiri Thanksgiving Event
2nd：Dullahan Purgatorium
3rd：Ware the Scythe's Temptation Event
4th：Akitsu, Kusatsu, and the Peerless Event
5th：Unraveling of the Spider Lily Event
6th：Assault! Cursect Princess -Puragtorium-
7th：Dressed Up to Go Out Event
8th：Lucifer and Satan's Favorite Event
9th：Bright Oni Surpassing History Event
10th：Quietly Blooms Alone Event
11th：Forward on the Long Path Event
12th：Headless Warrior and the Bumpkin Event

[b]Comment：[/b]
The first place was the Onigiri Thanksgiving event, and coming in second and onward were events with the man rewards including skills, weapons, and magatama.
This year will make Onigiri's 10th anniversary, so we will keep these result in mind in order to bring an event which appeals to you, the players of Onigiri!


[h3]Q.What would you like to see updated in the future? (Select up to 2)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/245ee46b159b22e1a28b49e56035cb7be3c63855.png[/img]
1st：Quality of Life Improvements (Storage expansion, UI improvements, etc)
2nd：Main Story Update
3rd：New Events
4th：Purgatorium Dungeons
5th：New Vanguard Characters
6th：New Battle Mounts
7th：High difficulty dungeons
8th：Implement new Support partners


[b]Comment：[/b]
We've heard a lot of requests for storage expansion and msq updates.
Having received so many requests, we recognize that we have kept you waiting for these additions for some time and we will endeavor to live up to your expectations in these regards.


[hr][/hr]

[h2]Questions About Partner Characters[/h2]

※Gold Rank Nyankoropon characters are not eligible.

There was a great span in the number of votes for the Vanguard, Divine Possession, and Battle Mount characters when excluding Support characters, but breaking down the votes into service types provided an interesting result.

[h2]Open Answer[/h2]
[h3]Q. If you have any other suggestions, comments, or feedback to give, please let us know.[/h3]

Some of the most popular comments include:
・Please update the Main Story
・Please expand the inventory/storage
・Please improve the lag/client crashing
・Please re-release specific events
・Please review the Nyankoropon lineup


[b]Comment：[/b]
In addition to the item amnagement/storage improvements and MSQ update requests we received, we heard many requests for improvements regarding system issues. We'll keep these requests in mind and work together with the systems and development teams to continually improve our service.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Notice Concerning Popular Nyankoropon Questionnaire[/h2]

In August of 2023 we will be implementing Nyankoropon featuring the popular Vanguards, Battle Mounts, Divine Possessions, and Support characters  based upon the results of the questionnaire you have all been so kind as to fill out.
※Collaboration characters will be exclusded.

Thank you for your attention to the results of the Onigiri 2023 Questionnaire.

We appreciate all of the time and effort from those who have cooperated.

Thank you for your support of Onigiri.

During the event period,  Assault! Dullahan Purgatorium, has been added to the purgatorium dungeons!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but 
the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[b]■About Items from the Dullahan Purgatorium dungeon[/b]
　・The Dullahan Purgatorium Boss will drop the following items:

　　　Hard Difficulty → Headless Warrior's Horn

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasures[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[b]■Unlocking Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
Plater must clear the [To Kishinden] quest and speak to the NPC Chifuri 
in the Temporal Rift in order to open these dungeons.

notes.title: New Charater Yagyu Jubei Added!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team!

On 6/8/2023 JST the new character
[b]Yagyu Jubei[/b] will be added! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/364dfe73f80b769b8935eeca49ba5bfe858c1446.png[/img]
CV：Hasegawa Rena

The new character [b]Yagyu Jubei[/b] can be added to your ranks
bu using the Summoner's Scroll - Yagyu Jubei. Moreover, the character can be
used for a [b]Vanguard Swap[/b] to fight as her as well!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]About the [Termination Moon] Gauge[/h2]

Jubei has a dedicated gauge system, the [b]Termination Moon Gauge[/b],
which will display on the bottom right of the screen during vanguard swap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8b51f6d22ba17bc5feb8d8d70a8f0ef952d96b22.png[/img]

The Termination Moon Gauge is filled by using skills. Filling the gauge will unlock access to the Blade Form Moon 12 - Termination Moon skill, which transforms the sheath of the special blade Gekkamukyu Kaneuji.
After activating the Blade Form Moon 12 - Termination Moon skill the gauge will start declining, but skills used while the sheath is transformed will deploy additional attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/aa2f6c9e56339b2a24725fa6e45c9775722f9866.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]About the Combo Skill[/h2]

Yagyu Jubei's skills are all [b]combo skills[/b].
Pressing the skill button at the right time after activating the skill will [b]increase the damage limit for one second[/b], [b]increases the Termination Moon Gauge[/b] and impart such effects as [b]adding additional hitboxes[/b].
The proper timing for the skills will have a special effect and sound effect, so be sure to practice to get the timing right!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/cd2080ca7a199e50a36a9f90e71734c1e0de9b26.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Skill Introduction[/h2]

Some of Jubei's skills will be introduced below.
[b]※Acquisition of skills is dependent on Awakening and Partner level.[/b]

[h3]■Blade Form Moon 4 - Dying Flower Moon[/h3]
Form a slash attack that remains in place while you jump backwards.
The jump direction changes depending on the directional key entered while attacking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ada4cb72d3268f61dd5605ea26cd25adc7448ca1.png[/img]

[h3]■Blade Form Moon 9 - Long Night Moon[/h3]
Cut through the enemy before you with a powerful slash.
Choose the right timing in order to overwhelm your opponent with force!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b25fcd51ee8ca0dd121443ccf0bcd2351196bff1.png[/img]

[h3]■Blade Form Moon 11 - Frost Moon[/h3]
A fascinating technique that fires skills like an artful Kagura dance.
A flurry of light movements make it a breeze to keep up with swift enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c89b69f836a95ed92a559c80d3bf407022fd424c.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Be sure to take the chance to make [b]Yagyu Jubei[/b] your partner with her brilliat blade skills!

※Images are taken during development and may not reflect final implementation.
※Update contents are subject to change without notice.

Thank you for your attention.
We appreciate your support for Onigiri!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1bc9c97ae7debaf35193f2b267eaf17d4899705c.jpg[/img]

During the event period, the warding dungeon [b][Abyss Gagoyle -Puragtorium-][/b] will be available.
Purgatorium dungeons appear irregularly, but you can get the exclusive Purgatorium Treasure items!

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but 
the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[b]■About Items from the Abyss Gargoyle Purgatorium dungeon[/b]
　・The Abyss Gargoyle Purgatorium Boss will drop the following items:

　　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Abyss Icicle
　　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Abyss Thunder
　　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Abyss Flame

[b]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasure[/b]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but 
the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[b]▼Exchange Item List[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/17542944493f9fe4d38f0daa15ef0d1f934cdca2.png[/img]

　Until maintenance 6/8/2023 JST

　● [Render Distance] and [Effect Display Range] and  can be set in a range of 1 ~ 10.
　● [Character Display Number] and [Stall Display Number] can be set in a range of 1 ~ 5.
　● [Effect Rendering] will allow players to choose effect render targets.

　● [Special Effects] will be changed to [Other Effects].

・A confirmation window will appear when choosing to leave a chat group.

・When chat information cannot be retrieved, a window will be displayed with the option to Leave.

・Fixed an issue where, when moving between stages in a party and a party member was riding a Battle Mount, the corresponding member would not be displayed properly in their icons or the party list.

・Fixed an issue where, when moving between stages in a party and a party member switched to a Vanguard Partner with an Outfit Change equipped, the Outfit Change would not be appropriately applied.

notes.title: New Character Uesugi Kenshin - Scarlet Bloom Added!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

On the 4/13/2023 JST update the new character Uesugi Kenshin - Scarlet Bloom was added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3c854b37ef6bdc791d66f314e4dd8edff0ee909c.png[/img]

Uesugi Kenshin - Scarlet Bloom can be obtained by using a Summoning Scroll obtainable from the Nyankoropon.
Players can also perform a Vanguard Swap with Kenshin - Scarlet Bloom, as well as summoning her as an ally.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Sake[/h3]
Kenshin - Scarlet Bloom has a special sake that can be drunk after a Vanguard Swap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0540ae3adf179145c285beed270e7ac71503a7b8.png[/img]

■Junmai Daiginjyou [Dragon Killer]
・Darkness Attribute +10
・Ice Attribute +10
・Recovers with 1 HP after a fatal hit one time.

Strengthen yourself with drink and prepare for the worst with this unique Sake!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Skill Introduction[/h3]
A portion of the skills will be featured below.
Many of Kenshin - Scarlet Bloom's skills increase in power as her HP decreases.

[b]■Scarlet Dragon Dead Ground[/b]
Creates a glyph at the opponent's feet which generates a huge ice cube to freeze the enemy.
A useful skill when you want to attack but can't get close to your opponent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/dd1863c2927fccfd26808402be7182ad3e749552.png[/img]

[b]■Ougi Scarlet Dragon Red Grave[/b]
Rush the enemy at blinding speed and attack at the heart without missing. 
Integrating offense and defense, this move allows you to evade the enemy's attack to get behind them for an attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0338f248c03a6cf7a7a8b4e2e1979f0f1d74f8ad.png[/img]

[b]■Ougi Scarlet Dragon Cold Gratitude[/b]
Consumes 20% hp and slashes the enemy from all directions with mirages.
This skill is easy to utilize and attacks in a wide range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4b63afe7fb381aade0f42b48042b8019ed771161.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Be sure to befriend this partner character and take advantage of her unique speed and Iai skills!

※Images are taken during development.
※Update contents are subject to change without notice.

Thank you for your attention.
We appreciate your support for Onigiri!

[b]◆Furniture Sale Period[/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]・[Unraveling of the Spider Lily] Event Begins![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c31125af5cf02b85e164173f73fd8df0b9ce924a.jpg[/img]

~Synopsis~
Kenshin seems to have gone missing.
A retainer to the Uesugi family claims she left a note saying she was headed for Sado Island,
but after three days gone everyone has started to worry.
[Seek the Oni in Onigashima if anything goes wrong,] her note stated.

※This quest becomes available upon completion of the Main Story Quest 
 [To Sadoshima] and the Subquest [Frozen Wings]

Begin the quest by speaking to Shingen in Onigashima.

※During the event quest, the portal to Sado Island in Echigo will temporarily disappear.

[b]◆Event Item and Bonuses◆[/b]

notes.title: [COMPLETE] 4/7 Emergency Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
[h3][4/7 Notice][/h3]
The emergency maintenance begun [b]on 12:00 am PDT 4/7, 2023 has concluded as of 2:00 am PDT.[/b]

[h3]■Bug Fixes[/h3]

・A bug in the "Magatama Ornamentation" of the NPC "Kaguya", where the type of elements granted by the Magatama Ornamentation "Lion Skull" were different from those notified.
　The Poison and Flight elements were not candidates for the elements to be given.

　We have sent compensation for the above bug to all players who have done the targeted Ornamentation.

[hr][/hr]

As compensation for the emergency maintenance, we will be sending the following items.

[b]■Compensation Items[/b]
・Full Energy Restorative x1

[b]◆Validity[/b]
　Accounts existing as of 12:00 am  PDT, 4/7, 2023

※Items will be delivered to an account's present box.
　Gifts can be received by navigating to the [Menu] → [System] → [Present] screens.
※Item can only be recieved by one character per account, so please select the correct character.
※Compensation items will not be destributed on a specific schedule.


Thank you for your attention.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
Thank you for supporting Onigiri!

[hr][/hr]
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

We will be conducting maintenance on April 7th at 12:00 am PDT.
This maintenance is expected to finish at [b]3:00 am PDT on April 7th[/b].

[b]※Players will not be able to login during this time.
※We will post a notice at maintenance's conclusion, so please do not try to log in during this time.
※Please note that the end time of maintenance is subject to change without prior notice.[/b]

We appreciate your patience and understanding.

notes.title: [Addendum]New Character Akechi Mitsuhide Added!
notes.content:
[12/22 Notice]
-Part of the description has been revised.


Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

Beginning on 1/1/2023 JST the new Vanguard character
[b]Akechi Mitsuhide[/b] will be added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/459a41ae431c3e5949df932b408cc90ed59f125d.png[/img]

The new Vanguard Akechi Mitsuhide will be available with Summoning Scroll - Mitsuhide.
Players will also be able to control her and give her orders with Vanguard Swap.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]About the Destruction Gauge[/h2]

Mitsuhide has a unique [b]Destruction Gauge[/b], and when in Vanguard Swap a flower-shaped
Destruction Gauge will appear on the upper right of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/dfacb59bac767de2a6008f1c3e3fdc3ff08ee842.png[/img]

The Destruction Gauge has 10 petals that increase and decrease when using certain skills.
The number of skill icons displayed next to the skill name will reveal how many petals are imparted.
※Some skills will not influence the petal count.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/68d4e85acedf0fbe7edf929d28ba71ce5fa410d3.png[/img]

Powerful skills will require more petals, so chain your skills effectively and devastate the battlefield!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]About the Special Action Hyousa Shoudou:[/h2]

Mitsukide has a special action named [b]Hyousa Shoudou[/b].
Hyousa Shoudou can be activated by pressing Guard + Dash
and consumes one Destruction Gauge petal.Shoot an ice chain in the direction of aim with the left hand, 
and pull mItsuhide to the point of impact when it contacts the wall or ground.

Use this special skill to control the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ffa6d80b9d659e4edc59fc89c2e492bad5d0302e.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Skill Introduction[/h2]
Some of Mitsuhide's skills will be introducrd below.
※Skill acquisition is dependent on partner awakening level and friendship level.

[b]■Kabu Houtenkaika[/b]
Attack with the chain from the left while using the scythe like a swing
to attack your enemies, all in motion!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/be240b3d9e652d6575cad8917fb63efd511d4ee2.png[/img]


[b]■Kabu Hitenkaika[/b]
Throw the scythe horizontally in a large arc to attack the enemy.
Press the jump button while the weapon is out of her hand [strike]before the weapon hits the enemy[/strike] and Mitsuhide teleports to the scythe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/d6a2a84e0f1be32ffbb1402fd0fe34d30346c8f1.png[/img]


[b]■Kabu Mikotogarinohana[/b]
A powerful buff that increases damage limit and critical hits in exchange for defense.
It can only be used once each Vanguard Swap.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/03e3b10fe205f6d6ee9a063a9b50b5dd6c5d6de1.png[/img]


[b]■Ougi Kabu Hyousa Tengai[/b]
Raise your left hand and shoot multiple chains from above the enemy to attack.
Imparts the slow effect to some enemies, especially mobs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/d5151f22898526319ca40790dcd5318e5b82e53d.png[/img][hr][/hr]
Let's rampage around the battlefield with the clever and peculiar fighter that is Akechi Mitsuhide!

※Images are taken during development and may not reflect the final product.
※Update details are subject to change without notice.

Thank you for your attention.
We appreciate your support for Onigiri!

notes.title: [COMPLETE] 11/18 Emergency Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
【11/18 Addendum】
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The emergency maintenance begun on 11 pm PST 11/17, 2022 has
concluded as of 1 am PST 11/18.

[h3]Update Details[/h3]
-Changed so that partner characters cannot be summoned in fields that are treated as towns, such as [Onigashima] and [Gratitude Gala Grounds] fields.
 *At a later maintenance, some areas, such as Onigashima, will be able to summon them as usual.

-Portals to the event dungeons [Gratitude Gala Kishiden] and [Gratitude Gala Training Grounds] have been set up in the field [Onigashima].


As compensation for the emergency maintenance, we will be sending
the following items.

[b]■Compensation Items[/b]
・Full Energy Restorative x1

[b]◆Validity[/b]
　Accounts existing as of 11 am PST, 11/17, 2022

※Items will be delivered to an account's present box.
　Gifts can be received by navigating to the [Menu] → [System] → [Present] screens.
※Item can only be recieved by one character per account, so please select the correct character.
※Compensation items will not be destributed on a specific schedule.


Thank you for your attention.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
Thank you for supporting Onigiri!

[hr][/hr]
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

We will be conducting maintenance on November 17th at 11 pm PST.
This maintenance is expected to finish at [b]1 am PST on November 18th[/b].

※Players will not be able to login during this time.
※We will post a notice at maintenance's conclusion, so please do not try to log in during this time.
※Please note that the end time of maintenance is subject to change without prior notice.[/b]

We appreciate your patience and understanding.

　These dungeons feature both a [b]solo version[/b] and

　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b05efd1e22c069d63ee8c6f37f8e77069f186256.png[/img]

Summary
A rumor has been spreading that saltpeter has been found in an uninhabited island in Onigashima.
Hearing such a tale, Nobunaga and Ieyasu gather their subordinates to mine the precious substance.
However, the Youkai which live on the island impede their progress...

Talk to Honda Tadakatsu in Onigashima in order to undertake this quest.

[h3]◆Event Item and Bonuses◆[/h3]
Event items can be obtained by clearing each event dungeon.
Also, under certain conditions, the number of event items received upon clearing a dungeon will increase.

[h3]◆Event Rewards◆[/h3]
Talk to the event NPC Tokugawa Ieyasu in order to exchange the event limited items for great prizes.

◆ [b]Matori Kakeru X Tokugawa Ieyasu Poster Signed[/b]：Clear the [Abandoned Isle (Ieyasu)] Dungeon 15 times.
※Please note that the [Abandoned Isle] and [Abandoned Isle (Ieyasu)] dungeons are different.

・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

notes.content:
[h3][Addendum 7/28/2022 JST][/h3]
The [b]17:00 7/28/2022 JST [/b] maintenance has been completed.


[h3]■Bug Fixes[/h3]
・After the update on July 4, 2022, a bug existed where if certain items were purchased in the  Nintendo Switch™ version, 
a different item from the one which was attempted to be bought was purchased.

Shopping Plaza on the Nintendo Switch™ version.

the following items.

[b]◆Validity[/b]
　Accounts existing as of 15:00, 7/28/2022 JST

※Item can only be recieved by one character per account, so please select the correct character.

Thank you for your attention.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
Thank you for supporting Onigiri!

[hr][/hr]

We will be conducting maintenance on July 28th at 15:00 JST.
This maintenance is expected to finish at [b]17:00 JST on July 28th[/b].

[b]※Players will not be able to login during this time.
※We will post a notice at maintenance's conclusion, so please do not try to log in during this time.

Shizuka, Miroku, Musashi, and Lancelot will receive Outfit Changes in these packs!
These Outfit Change Packs can be found in the Shopping Plaza, are limited to one sale each, each cost 300 OC, and contain the following items:
New Avatar Parts [Gang Jacket] and [Brawler Sarashi] have been added!
This gang is for life! Show your rebellious side with these unorthodox
These new parts and undergarments can be obtained in the new Nyankoropon!
Players can spin Katsuie's Treasure Chest Nyankoropon by trading the Nirvana Cassava available from Chifuri's Wardings.
It takes 2 Nirvana Cassava for each roll, or 20 Cassava for 10 rolls of the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon.
The prizes in the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon are limited in number and will be replenished when the Nyankoropon refreshes.
Those items which have not been won when the Nyankoropon refreshes can no longer be won.
Additionally, players can also obtain exchange tickets for Golden Series furniture from the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon!
It appears that Inuchiyo has found herself in a grave situation! The string that served as Matsu’s momento and sealed her Youkai power has come undone, so she cannot return to Toshiie Maeda’s form!
It seems that the culprit behind this is somewhere on the island, so it’s up to you to look for clues and find them
During the event period, talk to Popogoro in Onigashima to get to the Festival Grounds.
Talk to Sasuke in the Festival Grounds in order to undertake the quest!
Players can obtain event items as drops from monsters in the event dungeons and as clear rewards.
Also, by clearing the event dungeons under certain conditions players can obtain even more rewards!
Continue the quest to unlock the exchanges of NPC Sasuke and Ibaraki, as well as
Treasure Chest Nyankoropon from Inuchiyo and Genbu.
You can exchange the exclusive event drop items for great rewards!
Exchanging the Glistening Shell and Crystal of Decease at the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon
for a chance at the Sailor Suit Sasuke Summoning Scroll!
Don't miss out on the many other great prizes!
During the event period, [b]Sleetsword Gargoyle[/b] Purgatorium dungeon has been added!
Players can obtain not only the regular rewards, but also Purgatorium Treasures from this challenge!
Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.
Purchase Onigiri Coins at set amounts during the campaign period
and get bonus rewards sent straight to your in-game mailbox!
