notes.title: 6/6/2022 JST Update Notice
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The details of the 6/6/2022 JST maintenance are as follows.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Character [Amakusa Shirou] Added![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/897817c4d9075f32909554bdba5f45e0b5e8ffe7.png[/img]

Beginning 6/6/2022 JST, the new vanguard Amakusa Shiro will be introduced!

Shiro can be summoned with a Summoner's Scroll obtained from the new Nyankoropon
or the Yorozu Exchange for 120x Limited Yorozu Tickets.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・MyRoom Official Service Begins![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/64c96dd2fa6a27a30ead6c58609323c38ed0cf2b.jpg[/img]

The MyRoom official service will be implemented!

The following will occur as a result of this implementation.
・All MyRoom furniture and related items will be returned to the player's inventory.
・The layout of MyRoom will change.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]New Sublime Ougi Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2873a31cfb3167a7e1e3394a3b00c51e8f412a60.jpg[/img]

The following new sublime Ougi can be found in the Sublime Ougi Nyankoropon!

[b]・Sword Ougi Log Rumble Tornado - Sublime[/b]
[b]・Oodachi Ougi Log Rumble Strike - Sublime[/b]
[b]・Axe Ougi Log Rumble Strike - Sublime[/b]
[b]・Spear Ougi Log Rumble Tornado - Sublime[/b]
[b]・Twin Blade Ougi Log Rumble Tornado - Sublime[/b]
[b]・Bow Ougi Log Rumble Toss - Sublime[/b]
[b]・Wand Ougi Log Rumble Toss - Sublime[/b]
[b]・Staff Ougi Log Rumble Toss - Sublime[/b]

[b]▼Ougi Log Rumble Strike - Sublime[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c7ff7579da025a8b66df49d1e776f8812b0ea4a6.png[/img]

[b]▼Ougi Log Rumble Tornado - Sublime[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/79ee9a3707d8ead1b1fd7ab6e834f5743369adba.png[/img]

[b]▼Ougi Log Rumble Toss - Sublime[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0b70d9b6b3327c65738b392427b3b68da5fc423b.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Nyankoropon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3a5d976ed156180e4ea51d5011011f20d0619256.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c137eced974a682a1f0ac0d6bd6c05be153c017d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e2c77523181089afbe7791cb42e937d6bb01554e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e32d2a949eb45993f435cf4dbf2e56a86bfeea13.jpg[/img]

Players can find not only Amakusa Shiro in the new Nyankoropon, but also
the new Blaze Magatama!
This magatama can grant a buff that raies the damage limit,
granting players the ability to reach even greater feats of damage!

In honor of the MyRoom service official start, we will also be adding two new MyRoom Nyankoropon!

New Nyankoropon details can be found here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/93700/web]6/6 Nyankoropon Details[/url]
New materials for the creation of an upgraded Blaze Magatama will also be added.
※New magatama recipes are added automatically based on Kaguya's partner level.

[hr][/hr]
・New Avatar Parts Added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3b215ca24b804c93e86ed7f02c5c5a12fb896095.png[/img]

The new War Armor Avatar Part Series has been added!
Let these new looks propel your military strategy to new heights!

These Avatar Parts can be found in the new Nyankoropon as well!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Furniture Added![/h2]
Furniture in the shape of Amakusa Shiro's mini character Accessories will be added to the Shopping Plaza!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/aa7e902becb91ec71df435440a4775bb9f2c444f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/959df7b7eaf4f7cb94e79ef46077d15ce497bb29.png[/img]

　Reclining Sheeroh
　Sakura Flooring
　Square Wood Flooring
　Square Tatami Flooring
　Sakura Wallpaper
　White Walls and Tatami Floor
　Earthen Walls and Wallpaper
　Tatami Rug
　Blue Lattice Rug
　Red Plum Rug
　Modern Japanese Rug
　Yellow Lattice Rug
　Modern Bamboo Rug

The Reclining Character Series will cost 25 OC each and are limited to one purchase.
The Walls and Flooring will cost 25 OC each and are limited to one purchase.
Rugs will cost 20 OC each.

[h3]◆Furniture Availability[/h3]
　After maintenance 6/6/2022 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Magatama Ornamentation![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e60f8fb30dd8da37d108917037e546df84ec5175.jpg[/img]

New Magatama Ornamentartions including Fallen Daughter of God - Sword and Abyssal Depths - Twin Blade will be added!
※These new Ornamentations will be available dependent on the Ornamentation level of the player's Kaguya.

Check here for more information.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/93896/web]About new Magatama Ornamentation[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Makami Outfit Change Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/7eb74fd922ef5488953f451e6d4c6b1e9b5f26f6.png[/img]

The Battle Mount Oguchi Makami will be receiving an
Outfit Change Sublime - Makami!
※This Outfit Change has no effect on skills.

This Outfit Change can be found in the Shopping Plaza for
50 Paid OC, is limited to one purchase, and includes the following items.

　・Outfit Change Sublime - Makami x1
　・Limited Gacha Ticket x1

[h3]◆Makami Outfit Change Pack Sale Period[/h3]
　After maintenance 6/6/2022 JST
　Until maintenance 7/4/2022 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・[Headless Warrior and the Bumpkin] Event Begins![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b3ca518015937e53fc26e7e7daec42816676339e.jpg[/img]

Summary
It seems like Gennai is looking for a man named Amakusa Shiro, who's visiting Kyoto.
Along with Musashi, wo wants to see the sword he carries,
the party sets out in search of Shiro!

During the event period, talk to Hiragi Gennai to begin the quest.
※The Main Quest [Repairing Benkei] must be completed to begin this quest.
※The NPC Gennai may be relocated from her house temporarily.

[h3]◆Event Item and Bonus◆[/h3]
Event items can be obtained by clearing each event dungeon. Also, by meeting certain conditions, players can get more event items when clearing.

[h3]◆Event Rewards◆[/h3]
Clear the event quest to unlock Amakusa Shiro's event exchange.
Trade the event items for various exclusive rewards!

[h3]▼Exchange Reward List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c22442b45ccf58f19ba2b86961d97245649193d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3656828624588cd813b58a5748f439e1f82ec5c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/642ddc994170e5d5089d7ff6de371370fe491601.png[/img]

・Esoteric Tome of The Kamikui
・Superior Bamboo Sword - Black
・Superior Bamboo Sword - Red
...as well as many others!

[h3]◆Event Period[/h3]
　After maintenance 6/6/2022 JST
　Until maintenance 7/4/2022 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Purgatorium Dungeon Hades Eleos Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2b35a9d7d64768b07620556745d45da33ea78301.png[/img]

Talk to Chifuri in order to challenge Hades Eleos!
This dungeon is available in three difficulties.

[h3]■About the Warding Dungeons[/h3]
Clear the quest [To Onigashima] and speak to Chifuri in the [Temporal Rift]
in order to open the Wardings.


・New Golden Dragon Weapons Added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/61cb3f8a59a347b79a81f1340d19f6d1e8c1cb79.png[/img]

Players can obtain the materials to forge the Golden Dragon weapons
as drop items from the Hades Eleos Warding dungeon.

※Stronger weapons are isplayed further down the table.
※Grace variety weapons cannot be sold in player stalls.

You can obtain the recipe and raw materials in the dungeon depending on the degree of difficulty you challenge it on (challenging it on Hell has a greater chances or dropping the items than on Normal).
When crafting the "Reminiscence" and "Grace" weapons, the weapon rank below is necessary. Example: Golden Dragon of Light - Reminiscence needs Golden Dragon of Light, and Golden Dragon of Light - Grace needs Golden Dragon of Light - Reminiscence in order to be crafted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1dd01fe800e96e6124a38144b7c04a08ae6eb2de.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Purgatorium Dungeon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/f3806b3ceb9f5f0f60a07a38d225f6f3c26314bf.jpg[/img]

During the event period, the Levinlance Gargoyle Purgatorium dungeon will be added.
In the Purgatorium Wardings, you can find Purgatorium Treasures in addition to the items that normally drop!

[h3]■About Purgatorium Treasures[/h3]
　- You can exchange Purgatorium Treasures for various items through the NPC Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo.
- The Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo NPC will only appear while the Purgatory dungeons are active. The item exchange lineup will change depending on what warding is currently active.
- Purgatorium Treasures that are not exchanged during the time that the Purgatorium dungeon is active will turn into Junk, but this item can be exchanged for Purgatorium Treasures when the next Purgatorium Dungeon is active.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Amakusa Shiro Login Bonus Campaign Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/de30c2c89713f5b1703a3037330eb20fc7af01a6.jpg[/img]

During the event period, login every day in order o obtain great prizes including SP Gacha Tickets!
※This login calendar does not loop.

[h3]◆Login Bonus Calendar Period[/h3]
　From 4:00 on 6/7/2022 JST
　Until 3:59 on 7/4/2022 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Cumulative Purchase Campaign Begins![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/d906bfd5dc852b84d1a13235b018deed2b184197.jpg[/img]

Buy OC during the event period and get prizes sent directly to your present box
when purchases reach certain thresholds!

[h3]■Present List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b7a666f335cf542cbc73dd3404b41259b856cc04.png[/img]

[h3]◆Campaign Period[/h3]
　From 14:00 on 6/6/2022 JST
　Until 14:00 on 7/4/2022 JST

[h3]◆Item Validity[/h3]
　Until 14:00 on 7/4/2022 JST

Check additional details here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/event/93497/web]Cumulative Purchase Campaign[/url]

[hr][/hr]
Details about other events can be found here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/93493/web]6/6 Update Contents[/url]

Thank you for your attention!
※Images are created during development and are subject to change.
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

notes.title: 【Addendum】4/11 Update Information
notes.content:
【5/6 Addendum】
・New character details have been added.


Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The details of the 4/11/2022 JST update are as follows.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Character Battle Maiden Shizuka Added![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/812db056796438d8fdd187aa20b159df75af64fe.png[/img]

The new Vanguard character Battle Maiden Shizuka will be added!

You can collect Battle Maiden Shizuka's summoning scrolls from the Nyankoropon,
or from the Yorozu exchange for 120 Limited Yorozu Tickets.
[b]※Players can collect from Yorozu exchange after maintenance 5/9 JST[/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Nyankoropon Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/51b4d96bcd5f71c531d06f49577dab7eaf1a176d.jpg[/img]

You can find the new Battle Maiden Shizuka from the Shizuka Nyankoropon!

Look for additional details here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/91984/web]4/11 Nyankoropon[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]New Ougi Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4d0076733438ddc1d3827a2342079237f744bfad.jpg[/img]

New Ougi have been added to the Nyankoropon!
These new Ougi impart a buff that temporarily raises the damage limit!

　[b]・Sword Ougi Thunderbolt Focus[/b]
　[b]・Oodachi Ougi Heavenfire Fall[/b]
　[b]・Axe Ougi World Cleaver[/b]
　[b]・Spear Ougi Swirling Torrent[/b]
　[b]・Twin Blade Ougi Wind in the Trees[/b]
　[b]・Bow Ougi Frozen Thorn[/b]
　[b]・Wand Ougi Calamitous Cannon[/b]
　[b]・Staff Ougi Rosary Strike[/b]

[b]▼Ougi Wind in the Trees[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/9ffa3edd217e326dda157527375b9f0e9483c2b2.png[/img]

[b]▼Ougi Calamitous Cannon[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/68e829d0eb5d029c9aec96e961ad323ddc4cfc45.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Dress-Up Avatar Packs Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3a5175be7cb99ceab2b08222453514664485d8d9.png[/img]

In the Shopping Plaza, you can find the newly added Dress Up packs, which give you the ability to dress your character as Shizuka and Miroku!

[h3]■Male Dress-Up Pack[/h3]
　・Male Avatar Parts Exchange Tickets x4
　・Limited Gacha Ticket x1
　・Smelting Amulet Transcendent Fortune x1
　・Ornamentation Amulet Transcendent Fortune x1

[h3]■Female Dress-Up Pack[/h3]
　・Female Avatar Parts Exchange Tickets x4
　・Limited Gacha Ticket x1
　・Smelting Amulet Transcendent Fortune x1
　・Ornamentation Amulet Transcendent Fortune x1

Each pack is 200 Paid OC apiece and is limited to one purchase per account.

※Both male and female packs may be purchased regardless of character gender, so please be certain to select the correct pack.
※These avatar part tickets cannot be sold in stalls.

[h3]◆Dress-Up Pack Sale Period[/h3]
　After maintenance 4/11 JST
　Until maintenance 5/9 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Dress-Up Avatar Parts (Shizuka) and (Miroku) Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/6c7fcb90370673079c73ac4d9a846a0d33e5c47a.png[/img]

The new Dress-Up Series avatar parts have been added!
You can find these parts in the new Nyankoropon.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・ New Furniture Items Added![/h2]
Players can find the mini Shizuka figure in the Shopping Plaza!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ee4227f5607c4d05795d05a40f48e900a10394af.png[/img]

[h3]■New Items[/h3]
　Reclining Battle Maiden Shizuka (Limited)

The Reclining Character Furniture Series will cost 25 OC and is limited to one purchase.

[h3]◆Item Sale Period[/h3]
　After maintenance 4/11 JST
　Until maintenance 5/9 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Shizuka and Miroku Outfit Changes Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c573f134f5746d0795cd5e4700ff7cd3d3041eb8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/9600a9e303336b220b7752bd061a27ef3f4fe004.png[/img]

Outfit Change packs give you the ability to change the look of your partner characters Shizuka and Miroku in their many variation!

These outfit changes are available from the Shopping Plaza in a set.
Each pack will cost 50 Paid OC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/92f59831a4cd7cd3b671fcebda9140abf7b8b7b3.jpg[/img]

Summary
Yoshitsune, breathless with worry, brings urgent news from Edo Castle...
Together with a nervous Shizuka, you make your way to the castle.
What is it that awaits in the eastern palace...?

Talk to Kichiji during the event period in order to get the quest started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e5f4ef7be47168bdebe61743e2d606edb6de4da7.png[/img]

[h3]◆Event Item and Bonuses◆[/h3]
Event items can be obtained by clearing each event dungeon. Also, if you meet certain conditions, you can get more event items when you clear.

[h3]◆Event Rewards◆[/h3]
Clear the event to open Lady Shizuka's item exchange.

[h3]▼Exchange Item Sample[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/238e754d300e4cc90c48726786f31586f5b39334.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/61fbf78a614e709b210207e066c85a54e5882171.png[/img]

・Ooku Lantern Furniture
・Ooku Shoji Furniture
And many others!

[h3]◆Event Period[/h3]
　After maintenance 4/11 JST
　Until maintenance 5/9 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Wardings Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1bc9c97ae7debaf35193f2b267eaf17d4899705c.jpg[/img]

During the event period, the Abyss Gargoyle Purgatorium dungeon will be added.
In the Purgatorium Wardings, you can find Purgatorium Treasures in addition to the items that normally drop!

[h3]■About Purgatorium Treasures[/h3]
　- You can exchange Purgatorium Treasures for various items through the NPC Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo.
- The Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo NPC will only appear while the Purgatory dungeons are active. The item exchange lineup will change depending on what warding is currently active.
- Purgatorium Treasures that are not exchanged during the time that the Purgatorium dungeon is active will turn into Junk, but this item can be exchanged for Purgatorium Treasures when the next Purgatorium Dungeon is active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/17542944493f9fe4d38f0daa15ef0d1f934cdca2.png[/img]

[h3]◆Abyss Gargoyle Purgatorium Availability[/h3]
　After maintenance 4/11 JST
　Until maintenance 5/9 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Battle Maiden Shizuka Bonus Login Campaign[/h2]

Login every day during the event period to get great prizes including [b]SP Nyankoropon Tickets[/b]!

※This calendar does not loop.

　From 04:00 4/12/2022 JST

[h2]Cumulative Purchase Bonus Campaign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/9925d4faa44c30af672625cab77923a177009208.jpg[/img]

Buy OC in set amounts and have bonus items mailed directly to your in-game mailbox!

[hr][/hr]

Thank you for your attention.

notes.title: 3/14 Update Information
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The details of the 3/14 Update Maintenance are as follows.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Character [Fuma Kotaro] Added![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/936cba12791dd4ae9a7f5e5dea4beea9c958478f.png[/img]

A new character, Fuma Kotaro, has been added!

Players can obtain Kotaro's summoning scroll from the New Nyankoropon 
as well as the Yorozu Exchange using 120x Limited-Time Yorozu Ticket 2022.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Nyankoropon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/77a03fe68cfaaa7d19c16dff67728589c198627d.jpg[/img]

Players can find the new ninja Fuma Kotaro in this Nyankoropon!

Look for the details here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/90387/web]3/14 Nyankoropon[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Fuma Kotaro Swimsuit Pack Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/be055b7d237919ecbaaf6079207324c9a8ed2aac.png[/img]

Players can find Kotaro's Outfit Change as well as other great items in the Shopping Plaza!

The Swimsuit Pack will cost 200 Paid Onigiri Coins. and contains the following items.

　・Limited Nyankoropon Ticket　x5
　・Smelting Amulet Transcendent Fortune　x1
　・Ornamentation Amulet Transcendent Fortune　x1
　・Max Durability +500 Ticket　x1

[h3]◆Outfit Change Pack Availability[/h3]
　After maintenance 3/14/2022 JST
　Until maintenance 4/11/2022 JST

[hr][/hr]
・New Furniture Added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ef1960f66e0dc49bcbacade8a4b66b44a50229b6.png[/img]

[h3]■A number of new character figures and posters have been added to the Shopping Plaza![/h3]
　Reclining Kotaro (Limited Time Only)
　Midsummer Ocean Poster (Limited Time Only)
　Midsummer Beach Poster (Limited Time Only)
　Summer Festival Poster (Limited Time Only)
　Summer Fireworks Poster (Limited Time Only)

The Reclining Character Series will cost 25 Paid OC the Posters will cost 20 OC each, 
and are limited to 1 purchase each.
These items will only be for sale for a limited time.

[h3]◆Limited Furniture Availability[/h3]
　After maintenance 3/14/2022 JST
　Until maintenance 4/11/2022 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Summer Vacation Furniture Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/74b41d78f2d255c217167590ba4231126d7d43c8.jpg[/img]

Just in time for late summer beach lounging!
Enjoy an eternal summer with this new furniture♪

Beach Parasol (3 colors)
Beach Chair (2 colors)
Mermaid Bed
Hayashi Chuka Flag
Dolphin Cushion」
Wall Mounted Surfboard (3 colors)
AC Unit (3 colors)

Find these ~cool~ new items in the Furniture Nyankoropon!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・[The Devil Rides In on the Waves] Event Begins![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1b808ad8d4b46a207202db2c6b58e2c46f4ae044.jpg[/img]

Synopsis
Sasuke is beyond excited upon hearing of the surfing competition this summer!
A masked girl amongst the tourists is watching her every move, however...
Is she related to the unexpected turmoil? Let's save the summer festival with new friends!

Talk to Sarutobi Sasuke in Onigashima to begin the quest.

[h3]◆Event Rewards◆[/h3]
Clear the event dungeons to get event items for the event exchange! Clearing the dungeons under certaun conditions will grant bonus items as well.

[h3]◆Event Rewards◆[/h3]
After clearing the quest, talk to Fuma Kotaro and exchange your event items for great rewards!
Look for new accessories, new avatar parts, and summoning scrolls!

[h3]▼Exchange Item Sample[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/80b4c6adf2a5fa0144ed1832fe98bda0c010044d.png[/img]

・Kotaro Muffler Accessory
・Head piece Fuma Demon Mask
・Manifestation Scroll - Surfboard
Look for other great rewards including Event Gacha Tickets!

[h3]◆Event Period[/h3]
　After maintenance 3/14/2022 JST
　Until maintenance 4/11/2022 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Battle Mount Surfboard Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/f639adf04866f93ca362fe1e70dd68316665d177.png[/img]

The new battle mount Surfboard is now available!
Ride in on your own personal wave every day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/fbf459e8d42ce096525b0b001caec27541036539.png[/img]

The Surfboard is available from the [Devil Rides in on the Waves] event!
※This mount's skills cannot be edited.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Avatar Parts School Swimsuits Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ffb1a0e4397aff14fc1697406dd1034710a9fdb3.jpg[/img]

Take a look at this year's summer special: School Swimsuit avatar parts have been added!
The Battle Mount Float Ring and School themed furniture have also been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a13e4f9d88ff7397f1235612ce8f88650e1b6750.png[/img]

You can find these items in the new Nyankoropon!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Kotaro's Login Bonus Campaign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4a8ce6a8874c8019d5da76aa1ef5dc8240a23803.jpg[/img]

Login during the event to get great rewards dependent on the number of days you login! 
Players can receive the Event Gift Gacha Ticket as well, so don't miss out!

[h3]◆Login Bonus Campaign Period[/h3]
　From 4:00 3/15/2022 JST
　Until 3:59 4/11/2022 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Purgatorium Dungeon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1a48664a27f9a676fe890e5f932bcfede117b250.jpg[/img]

During the event period, the Assault! Dragon Ark Aosame Purgatorium dungeon will be added.
In the Purgatorium Wardings, you can find Purgatorium Treasures in addition to the items that normally drop!

[h3]■About Purgatorium Treasures[/h3]
　- You can exchange Purgatorium Treasures for various items through the NPC Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo.
- The Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo NPC will only appear while the Purgatory dungeons are active. The item exchange lineup will change depending on what warding is currently active.
- Purgatorium Treasures that are not exchanged during the time that the Purgatorium dungeon is active will turn into Junk, but this item can be exchanged for Purgatorium Treasures when the next Purgatorium Dungeon is active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3946e8c6936ec1e29da60d74e26a32fc0325154c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/6f0aabcbb6d8a6cc02d77fc98c0f4ecd64e4c53e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/385b7bfd7769370b85b5aae8d34083d4af7bee27.png[/img]

・Uryuu Cloud Cleaver Recipe
・Rain Dragon Magatama
・Uryuu Cloud Cleaver manifestation Scroll

[h3]◆Purgatorium Availability Period[/h3]
　After maintenance 3/14/2022 JST
　Until maintenance 4/11/2022 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Special OC Purchase Bonus Campaign Begins![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c0aa14fa73d273e3c4c8292196776896021fb118.jpg[/img]

In honor of the new quest and characters, we're running a special purchase bonus campaign!

[h3]■Present List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8b95f2d776a6e685e1656c04603bcd7846857eaa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b4ae7006e891e1eea2ab1f00c84f9e3c1368af9b.png[/img]

◆Campaign Period
　From 14:00 3/14/2022 JST
　Until 14:00 4/11/2022 JST

◆Item Validity
　Until 14:00 4/11/2022 JST

Details can be found here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/event/90383/web]Purchase Bonus Present Campaign[/url]

[hr][/hr]

Other events and old event can be found here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/90382/web]3/14 Update Information[/url]

Thank you for your attention!
※Images are created during development and are subject to change.
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

notes.title: [COMPLETE]2/17 Emergency Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The emergency maintenance begun on 15:00 2/17, 2022 has
concluded as of 17:00 JST.

[h3]Amendments[/h3]
・Fixed a bug wherein the MyRoom could not be entered.

As compensation for the emergency maintenance, we will be sending
the following items.

[b]■Compensation Items[/b]
・Full Energy Restorative x1

[b]◆Validity[/b]
　Accounts existing as of 15:00 JST, 2/17, 2022

※Items will be delivered to an account's present box.
　Gifts can be received by navigating to the [Menu] → [System] → [Present] screens.
※Item can only be received by one character per account, so please select the correct character.
※Compensation items will not be destributed on a specific schedule.


Thank you for your attention.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
Thank you for supporting Onigiri!

[hr][/hr]
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

We will be conducting maintenance on February 17th at 15:00 JST.
This maintenance is expected to finish at [b]17:00 JST on February 17th[/b].

[b]※Players will not be able to login during this time.
※We will post a notice at maintenance's conclusion, so please do not try to log in during this time.
※Please note that the end time of maintenance is subject to change without prior notice.[/b]

We appreciate your patience and understanding.

notes.content:

As compensation for the emergency maintenanceon on 1/11, 2022, the following items have been sent.

-ALL Boost +200% (60Min.) x1
-Full Energy Restorative x1

[b]Validity[/b]
　Accounts existing as of 17:35 JST, 1/11, 2022

　Gifts can be received by navigating to the [Menu] → [System] → [Present] screens.
※Item can only be received by one character per account, so please select the correct character.
※Compensation items will not be distributed on a specific schedule.


Thank you for your attention.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for supporting Onigiri!

[hr][/hr]
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The emergency maintenance begun on 0:35 1/11, 2022 PST has
concluded as of 2:25 PST.

[h3]■Amendments[/h3]

・In the Steam version of Onigiri, there is a problem wherein players may not be able to log in normally beginning at 2:40 on January 11 JST.

※We will continue to investigate the disappearance of items due to this defect, and will announce any resolution and compensation at a later date.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for supporting Onigiri!

[hr][/hr]
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

We will hold maintenance on Thuesday, January 11, 2022 at 0:35 PST.
The maintenance end time has [b]yet to be determined[/b].

[b]※Players will not be able to login during this time.
※We will post a notice at maintenance's conclusion, so please do not try to log in during this time.
※Please note that the end time of maintenance is subject to change without prior notice.[/b]

We appreciate your patience and understanding.

and Riku and Tsukumo have been added to the Platinum Nyankoropon!

Beginning at 00:00 JST on January 1, 2022, the Summoning Scrolls

for [b]120 New Year Limited Yorozu Tickets[/b]!

can be found in the many delightful Nyankoropon available for the holidays!

You can find details for all of the Nyankoropon below.

Four new colors will be added to the Kyuubi Miko sets for men and women both!

These new avatar parts will appear in the seasonal Nyankoropon starting at 0:00 JST on January 1st!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・When the Fox Cries Event Begins![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/270ede5a18f990ae1e9fcd427ffac15d0aada9e9.jpg[/img]

***The Main Story Quest To Kyoto must be cleared before this quest can be started.

Summary
Kaguya, incensed at the sudden cancellation of the annual Manga Convention, is determined to go to Kyoto to see what can be done. Join her, Six, Ninety-Nine and the famous Murasaki Shikibu as they investigate the reason for the cancellation!

Talk to Kaguya in Onigashima starting January 1st at 00:00 JST to get the quest started.

[h3]◆Event Items and Bonuses◆[/h3]
Event items can be obtained by clearing each event dungeon. Also, if you meet certain conditions, you can get more event items when you clear.

[h3]◆Event Rewards◆[/h3]
Clearing the event will open Tsukumo's item echange.
Use the event items Red and White Fur, Charred Paper, and Foxfiend's Venom Sac to trade for exclusive rewards!

　From 0:00 1/1/2022 JST
　[strike]Until maintenance 1/24/2022 JST[/strike]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/25e8fdbadc621d800da94a24d3e386aad6c77446.jpg[/img]

During the event period, the warding dungeon [b][Assault! Dragon Ark Gakuhou][/b] will be available.
Purgatorium dungeons appear irregularly, but you can get the exclusive Purgatorium Treasure items!

[h3]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasure[/h3]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but 
the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

notes.title: [Addendum]12/6 Update Information
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The contents of the 12/6 maintenance are as follows.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Nyankoropon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3395c535f0db65851cbc4d740716e271ad921a5c.jpg[/img]
A number of new Nyankoropon, including ones where you can find special Divine Possession characters
have been added! Be sure to look fo the special discount roll Nyankoropon as well!

Look for further details here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/86701/web]12/6 Nyankoropon[/url]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]◆Gratitude Pack Sale Period[/h3]
　After maintenance 12/6/2021 JST
　Until maintenance 1/24/2022 JST

New furniture taking the shapes of Nobunaga, Lancelot, and Komachi will be added to the Shopping Plaza!

■Newly Added Furniture

◆Furniture Sale Period
　From maintenance 12/6/2021 JST
　Until maintenance 12/27/2021 JST

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8786616194ab7ffadf3a75de069f6ec10b8547b5.jpg[/img]

In Onigashima, a portal will be added so you can access the “Gratitude Gala Grounds!”

By clearing the dungeon “Gratitude Gala Kishinden” in the Gratitude Gala Grounds, you can collect materials to exchange for special items!

[h3]◆Event Item and Bonuses◆[/h3]
Event items can be obtained by clearing each event dungeon. Also, if you meet certain conditions, you can get more event items when you clear.

[h3]◆Event Rewards◆[/h3]
Players can open the NPC Mei item exchange by clearing the event quest.
Use event items to make the exchange!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/d1bd59fea1716e9ee557f98acc037687653f0362.png[/img]

There are other great items as well, so take a look!

[h3]◆Event Period[/h3]
　From maintenance 12/6/2021 JST
　Until maintenance 12/27/2021 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Purgatorium Dungeon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1bc9c97ae7debaf35193f2b267eaf17d4899705c.jpg[/img]

During the event period, the warding dungeon [b][Abyss Gargoyle -Puragtorium-][/b] will be available.
Purgatorium dungeons appear irregularly, but you can get the exclusive Purgatorium Treasure items!

[h3]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasure[/h3]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but 
the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

[h3]▼Exchange Item List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/17542944493f9fe4d38f0daa15ef0d1f934cdca2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/f6e2ededa1c8bfdd4aafbca694b5c0aadbff4c42.jpg[/img]

During the event period, get great items like the [b]Legend Nyankoropon Ticket[/b] according to the cumulative number of login days.

[h3]◆Login Bonus Campaign Period[/h3]
　From 04:00 12/7/2021 JST
　Until 03:59 12/29/2021 JST

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Cumulative OC Purchase Campaign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/d906bfd5dc852b84d1a13235b018deed2b184197.jpg[/img]

Purchase Onigiri Coins at set amounts during the campaign period
and get bonus rewards sent straight to your in-game mailbox!

[h3]■Present List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/b7a666f335cf542cbc73dd3404b41259b856cc04.png[/img]

◆Campaign Period
　From 19:00 12/6/2021 JST

Look for more details here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/86696/web]Purchase Bonus Campaign[/url]

[h2]・Welcome and Comeback Campaigns begin![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/078de845896b17550ab2cc0ef2249832bd899744.jpg[/img]

During the event period, generous reward items will be presented to newly registered accounts and accounts that have not logged in to Onigiri for a while!

[h3]■Present List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/04017378d9621628c8b0a81a21355b7d8d7201d1.png[/img]

[h3]■Welcome Campaign Eligible Accounts[/h3]

From 19:00 to 20:23 JST on December 3rd, the Welcome Campaign rewards were not distributed normally. If you are eligible for the Welcome Campaign and the gift has not been distributed to you, you can receive the gift by logging in again.

notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

On 11/24, 2021 JST we have released a patch for the Steam version of US Onigiri
to address certain issues as below.

We apologize to those who have logged in prior to distribution.
Please restart the Steam launcher and update Onigiri manually to apply the new patch.

The timing of the withdrawal of OC in the instance a refund is performed has been changed.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: New smartphone title "Onigiri HEROES" is now accepting pre-registration!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.
This is the Onigiri Service Team.

CyberStep is pleased to announce that pre-registrations for [b]Onigiri HEROES[/b], a MMORPG for smartphones set in fantasic Japan, is starting Wednesday, October 13, 2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0b4dc43038a3e9d9733eb74f924a4bd7d7a99372.png[/img]

[h3]"Onigiri HEROES" Official Website[/h3]
[url=https://heroes.onigiri.cyberstep.com]https://heroes.onigiri.cyberstep.com[/url]

[h3]"Onigiri HEROES" Official Twitter.[/h3]
[url=https://twitter.com/Onigiri_HEROES]https://twitter.com/Onigiri_HEROES[/url]


[h2]About the pre-registration campaign.[/h2]
In the pre-registration campaign, every time the number of pre-registrants exceeds a certain number, we will give away useful in-game items such as "Onigiri Coins" and "Gacha Tickets" that can be used when the official service starts. 
As well as characters to all players when the number of reaches 80,000 and 100,000.
Also when the number of pre-registrants reaches 80,000 and 100,000, characters will be given away to all players.
To pre-register, simply follow us on Twitter or register your email address using the dedicated form. The pre-registration process will be extended to the App Store and Google Play when they become available.

[h3]▼Pre-Registration Period[/h3]
Starting from October 13, 2021 until the start of owr official service
The period may subject to change without notice.

[h3]▼ How to pre-register[/h3]
Register your email address using the form on owr official website ([url=https://heroes.onigiri.cyberstep.com]https://heroes.onigiri.cyberstep.com[/url]).
Follow owr official Twitter account (@Onigiri_HEROES) ([url=https://twitter.com/Onigiri_HEROES]https://twitter.com/Onigiri_HEROES[/url])
Pre-order on the App Store (More information will be provided when available)
Register on Google Play (More information will be provided when available)

[h3]▼Pre-registration Prize[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/01d91a56c4e951fc7b1d1eaf80dcc92d04b1277a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ad4b27070f3d49851d0500502f49305cc6df270c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/9dc904ba8d16e78fcf4b00970e81c537caaa0eef.png[/img]

[h2]What is "Onigiri HEROES"?[/h2]
Onigiri HEROES" is a MMORPG for smartphones based on "Onigiri", which has been available on PC, PlayStation®4, Nintendo Switch™, Steam and other platforms since 2013 and has been played by over 5 million players worldwide. The operability of the game has been optimized for smartphones, allowing players to easily explore the world of Onigiri anytime and anywhere. The biggest features of "Onigiri HEROES" are "MMORPG set in ancient Japan" and "high action" which are unparalleled to other smartphone MMORPG.

[h3]◆ A Japanese-style fantasy MMO like no other![/h3]
In the vast world of Onigiri, a unique Japanese fantasy world awaits players, with many unique buildings and characters appearing in each field. The best part of "Onigiri HEROES" is that you can explore this world with other players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ca1f68202481538e257e035e4679e2c534ff9804.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c9d8b80a313c3d1e7b54a6a7656c1f51b7ae1b2c.jpg[/img]

[h3]◆ Enjoy the action with easy controls![/h3]
You can experience the exhilarating action of "Onigiri HEROES" with the simple operation. The addition actions such as guard and avoid action will give you an advantage in battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/07466eaea6f3279c1c886e6a5358f9f5c815f46e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ce1d847d111707443ea704aa1f1b5bf47524b8e2.jpg[/img]

In addition to the characters you control, "Onigiri HEROES" has a number ofcharacters who will fight alongside you.
Friend Characters include famous Japanese warriors and generals such as Musashi Miyamoto and Nobunaga Oda, as well as many unique characters such as Efreet and Gargoyle, some of which can  become controllable characters with completely different action.
You can enjoy a wide variety of actions that can be achieved with simple controls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a4848bb9fcdf0827229d7367543817a3c796ede1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/854ba2c058a11832626b300ff7b4d5557b94a465.jpg[/img]

[h3]◆ Optimized and improved for smartphones! [/h3]
We will make various optimizations and improvements so that more players can enjoy "Onigiri".

[b]・Improvement and optimization of game balance.[/b]
The balance of skills and equipment has been adjusted so that you can enjoy "Onigiri" even more on your smartphone.

[b]・Adjust pricing and difficulty of obtaining items.[/b]
We will review the methods and pricing of obtaining Friends characters and skills, and make adjustments so that players can easily obtain useful items and enjoy playing the game.

[b]・ Adjustment of other functions.[/b]
We are making adjustments to various functions in Onigiri.

The account information of "Onigiri" cannot be transferred to "Onigiri HEROES".
Cross-play with "Onigiri" is not available.

[h3]◆ "Onigiri HEROES" Game Overview[/h3]
Title: Onigiri HEROES
Genre: MMORPG
Distribution schedule: Late 2021
Supported OS: iOS / Android
Price: Free to Play (in-app purchases)
Official website: [url=https://heroes.onigiri.cyberstep.com]https://heroes.onigiri.cyberstep.com[/url]
Official Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/Onigiri_HEROES]https://twitter.com/Onigiri_HEROES[/url]

notes.title: 8/10 Update Contents
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri service team.

The contents of the August 10th 2021 JST Update Maintenance are as follows.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・New Character Murakami III Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/7e51906e22a58b90b4d6b72c70355ba318b5dba4.png[/img]
The new Vanguard character Captain Murakami III has been added!

Murakami III has a new feature, the Possession Gauge.
The Possession Gauge charges when Murakami makes regular attacks.
Murakami can trigger special attacks by using the possession gauge.

■Actions consuming the Possession Gauge
1. Special Artillery
Click the Guard key and Normal Attack buttons to activate this skill.
This technique is a non-elemental attack that ignores the enemy attribute resistance.
It consumes a small amount of Possession Gauge when activated.
* A certain number of Possession gauges are required to activate the skill.

2. Ghostly Possession
Click the Guard key and Skill Attack buttons to activate this skill.
After activating the skill, the exclusive buff "possession" activates and grants the following effects:

・HP is fixed at 1 regardless of damage received during effect's duration
・ Increased attack power
・ Increased damage limit

Also, after the possession buff wears off, normal HP recovery will not resume, so
 items and skills must be used to recover HP.
* You can use it only once during a dungeon.
* It can be activated 10 seconds after the vanguard change.
* To activate, the possession Gauge must be fully stocked.
* All possession Gauges are consumed upon activation.

Use these special skills to unleash torment upon your enemies with this new vanguard!

You can obtain Summoning Scrolls for Murakami III from the new Nyankoropon, 
or the Yorozu Exchange with new Summer Limited Exchange Ticket 2021.

※Summer Limited Exchange Ticket 2021 will be deleted during the next maintenance,
　 so please redeem them before that time.

[hr][/hr]

Each Swimsuit Pack (available from the Shopping Plaza) will cost 200 OC and inlcude the following items:

notes.title: 【Amend】7/12 Update Information
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The details of the July 12, 2021 update are as follows.

[h2]・New Nyankoropon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/5c5131fcc783d5fdbd983194e61ec2afd94c8943.jpg[/img]

The new characters [b][Inucho - Broken Seal] and [Genbu][/b] amongst others have been added to the Nyankoropon!

You can find the details of the Nyankoropon here.
[url=https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/81206/web]7/12 Nyankoropon List[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・[The Mystery of the Master and the Summer Festival] Event Begins![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/01a6bf4970b21bf48e57ba7fb1d0beff87bfe08b.jpg[/img]

[b]Synopsis[/b]
It appears that Inuchiyo has found herself in a grave situation! 
The string that served as Matsu’s momento and sealed her Youkai power has come undone, 
so she cannot return to Toshiie Maeda’s form!
It seems that the culprit behind this is somewhere on the island, so it’s up to you to look for clues and find them.

[h3]■Concerning the Vanguard Character [Sarutobi Sasuke - Sailor’s Suit][/h3]
Collect the exclusive event items to exchange them for
the Sarutobi Sasuke - Sailor’s Suit Summoning Scroll!

[b]●How to Obtain [Sarutobi Sasuke - Sailor’s Suit][/b]
Event Item Exchange (x2)
Treasure Chest Nyankoropon (x8)

[h3]◆Event Dungeon[/h3]
Event items can be obtained by clearing the dungeons.
If certain conditions are met you can even obtain bonus items!

[h3]◆Event Rewards◆[/h3]
Proceed with the quest to open up [b]Sarutobi and Ibaraki[/b] item exchanges, 
[b]Inuchiyo and Genbu[/b] will offer Treasure Chest Nyankoropons.
Exchange [Juicy Banana], [Soft Tail], and [Tenacious Tail] for various great rewards!
Exchange [Glistening Eggshell] and [Crystal of Deceased] at the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon,
where you can win the summoning scroll for Sailor Sasuke!

[h3]▼Exchange Item Sample[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c460a00064f8d33bdf9a46cfd9c4c8f9400864cf.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/fc5adbe22fc2d03f4a8d9c3e570a825a6a8e6895.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/e7f681c9acc9aba39307b26a7b5986951587c318.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3c7cb37a38b12814b91254a47dc54145f3828392.png[/img]

・Outfit Change - Sailor Suit Sasuke
・Avatar Parts Yukata Evening Calm - Cool Breeze
・Accessory Shashuke Sailor
・Accessory Ibuhraki Dawji - Summer Sky
・Accessory Chibi Eyeball
・Accessory Chibi Eyeball - Hidden
・Accessory Chibi Eyeball - Null

[h3]◆Event Period[/h3]
　From maintenance July 12, 2021
　[strike]Until maintenance August 9, 2021[/strike]
　Until maintenance August 10, 2021

[hr][/hr]
[h2]・Purgatorium Dungeon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/1a48664a27f9a676fe890e5f932bcfede117b250.jpg[/img]

During the event period, the warding dungeon [b][Assault! Dragon Ark Aosame -Puragtorium-][/b] will be available.
Purgatorium dungeons appear irregularly, but you can get the exclusive Purgatorium Treasure items!

[h3]■Concerning Purgatorium Treasures[/h3]
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

notes.title: 6/14 Update Information
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The details of the 6/14 update are as follows.

[h2]・New Character Mighty Byne Added!！[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/69dc75d8da7bb4d34602cad35c4c029af350215e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/7090e314b40e958b1fb75e6b57cc788ada20fc11.png[/img]
CV：Yūki Ishikari

The new Battle Mount character [b]Mighty Byne[/b], possessed of a iron-hard body that can withstand the onslaught of the firepower of multiple battle class dreadnoughts, has been added!

notes.content:
Greetings from The Onigiri Service Team. You can play a real-life crane game remotely through Cyberstep's app?! Exciting to watch and even more fun to play, [b]Toreba[/b] is celebrating 10 years of online crane game entertainment on April 26th, 2021! Starting on April 26, Toreba will be implementing a variety of campaigns in honor of its 10-year service anniversary! Join in Toreba's celebrations with a few games! ♪ [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/6698c176e6000d0863251d87aedc8b61fe1f0b34.jpg[/img] Click [url=https://www.toreba.net/special/10th_anniversary/index.html]here[/url] for more details. Enjoy it on your computer, smartphone app, Amazon Fire TV, Nintendo Switch ™, or other Internet devices. Each crane game machine has multiple angles, so you can always get a good view of the action. The prizes available very from stuffed animals and popular character figures to daily necessities, Japanese cultural goods and unique toys. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0d82da6602db8bfd66ead401f8bcad4268c81a6f.png[/img] [b]■Official Website:[/b] [url=https://www.toreba.net/]https://www.toreba.net[/url] [b]■Official Twitter:[/b] [url=https://twitter.com/cs_toreba]@cs_toreba[/url] [b]■Official Instagram:[/b] [url=https://www.instagram.com/cs_torebagram/]https://www.instagram.com/cs_torebagram[/url] [hr][/hr] ***Campaign details are subject to change without prior notice. the mysterious depths of the underworld...

indefinitely, and these enemies drop no items.

notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The contents of the 11/24 update are as follows.

[h2]New Character Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ae061d745a978f0a599bd14a9136dbbe7765696f.png[/img]

The new vanguard character, [b]Yorimitsu, Defender of the Imperial Family[/b], has been added!

[b]About Yorimitsu[/b]
Yorimitsu uses a [b]Burst Gauge System[/b], which will be visible on the 
bottom right of the screen during Vanguard Swap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0f9b6d5b14a7aa37506de406ddb897b0f89ee795.png[/img]

The Burst Gauge will be charged when using Skills or Ougi,
and charging the Gauge completely will give the player access to special skills!

Using Clashing Heavens will give the player buffs and increase Ougi strength.
The Burst Gauge will expire after a certain amount of time, but the duration
can be increased by attacking or using a Perfect Guard.

Moreover, while in Burst Mode, using Clashing Heavens
results in a beautiful dance of blades!
Doing so will expend all of the Burst Gauge, so be careful!

Using Awakenings for Yorimitsu will grant skill and equipable weapon bonuses,
and even new costumes as well!

At Awakening Lv1, Yorimitsu can use sword skills,
But at awakening Lv3 she can use Twin Sword and Bow skills,
and at Lv5 she can use Oodachi skills!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ec327561960e9f34539dc3c5bd813b93a2ab7cec.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3463f1f1b7d0699b1f31b6b89a71969a44f35ff9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/cd6d0476d9362c04f7d74ab6fa4cee66aec2749f.png[/img]

Additionally, at higher levels Yorimitsu's Clashing Heavens
skill will also increase in power!

notes.title: Special Item Pack Added!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

As of 18:00 on 7/13, the Special Item Pack Sale begins!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/6e3cac367b3d2c2b192dabdc13d161a0f3cd0a29.jpg[/img]

[h3]■Description[/h3]
This bargain Item Pack contains in-game currency and a number of limited items to help you on your "Onigiri" adventure!

[h3]■How to Purchase[/h3]
You can purchase this item pack through the Nintendo eShop and Steam.

[b]◆For the Nintendo Switch[/b]
　●Purchase is available from the Nintendo eShop.
[olist]
[*]Navigate to the Nintendo eShop and search for "Onigiri".
[*]Select the item pack from "In-game Items" and you will be redirected to a purchase screen.
[/olist]
　●Purchasing the Item Pack In-Game.
[olist]
[*]Press the - button to open the menu.
[*]Select the "Shopping Plaza" from the main menu and select "Special Item".
[*]Press the Shopping Cart button to display item details.
[*]Next, select the "To Nintendo eShop" button to proceed with purchase through the Nintendo eShop.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/f80b25d178786895ee75754b388ae4d23bcebd2f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2890810a95dea3bb59e1574c97707398c24aba40.jpg[/img]


[b]◆For Steam[/b]
　●Purchase is available from the Steam site.
[olist]
[*]Search "Onigiri" on the Steam page.
[*]Select the Item Pack under Game Contents and proceed to the purchase screen.
[/olist]
　●Purchasing the Item Pack In-Game.
[olist]
[*]Open the Menu by pressing the Esc or Alt keys.
[*]Select the "Shopping Plaza" from the main menu and select "Special Item".
[*]Press the Shopping Cart button to display item details.
[*]Next, select the "SteamShop" button to proceed with purchase through the SteamShop.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/657b8929de77871fa08ffd2e95629cf41daa0e91.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0b1d74c16f397a1af7e4fa010f6f5cad62a52bb0.png[/img]

[h3]■Item Pack Contents[/h3]
[b]◆Support Pack[/b]
Contents:
- Onigiri Coins: 300OC (Paid)
- Soul Egg x30
- Gacha Ticket x10
- Vanguard Basket -Support Pack- x1
- Accessory: Ghastly Ninjustsu manual x1

[b]▼Concerning the Vanguard Basket -Support Pack-[/b]
Using the Vanguard Basket -Support Pack- will randomly grant a Summoner's Scroll for one of the following characters:

Miyamoto Musashi
Dark Miyamoto Musashi
Sarutobi Sasuke
Himiko
Izuna Tri-Tail
Sakata Kintoki
Shuten-Douji
Oda Nobunaga
Lancelot
Uesugi Kenshin
Takeda Shingen
Gawain
Toyotomi Hideyoshi
Shibata Katsuie
Koujirou (Flying Swallow)
Ono no Komachi
*The drop rate for each character is identical.


[b]◆Premium Support Pack[/b]
Contents
- Onigiri Coins: 500OC (Paid)
- Soul Egg x50
- Gold Kompeitou x50
- EXP Boost +300% (60Min.) x3
- Ryou Boost +300% (60Min.) x3
- Drop Boost +300% (60Min.) x3
- Smelting Amulet Transcendent Fortune x3
- Oranmentation Amulet Transcendent Fortune x3
- Gacha Ticket x10
- Character Exchange Ticket -Premium Support Pack- x1
- Accessory Jounin's Wrap Hiei x1

[b]▼About the Character Exchange Ticket -Premium Support Pack-[/b]
Using the Vanguard Basket -Premium Support Pack- will grant a Summoner's Scroll for one of the following characters of your choice:

Miyamoto Musashi x1
Dark Miyamoto Musashi x1
Sarutobi Sasuke x1
Himiko x1
Izuna Tri-Tail x1
Sakata Kintoki x1
Shuten-Douji x1
Oda Nobunaga x1
Lancelot x1
Uesugi Kenshin x1
Takeda Shingen x1
Gawain x1
Toyotomi Hideyoshi x1
Shibata Katsuie x1
Koujirou (Flying Swallow) x1
Ono no Komachi x1
Tristan x2

[list]

Under certain conditions, extra items can be obtained upon dungeon clearing.

Exchange Event limted drop items with NPCs in order to 
get event limited reward items!

[b]Summary[/b]
Sasuke has come upon rumors of the biggest fish,
but hasn't had any luck catching it...
Help her beat her rival by reeling in Onigashima's biggest catch!

Event items can be obtained as a drop item from monsters and as dungeon rewards.
Under certain conditions, extra items can be obtained upon dungeon clearing.

Exchange Event limted drop items with Leviathan in order to 
get event limited reward items!
Check out Miroku's Shop to find a new selection of weapons!

The newly added weapons will mostly increase skill and defense.
Although the level is slightly high at 90, the durability is also high.
Weapon parameters will also increase according to player level.
Get great bonuses during the event period!

[b]EXP Gain +100%
・Ryou Gain +100%
・Item Drop Rate +100%
・Vanguard Gauge Rate +20%[/b]
The level cap will be increased from Lv130 to [b]Lv135[/b].
The Mystery of the Master and the Summer Festival Event has been extended.

When the cumulative purchase of OC reaches certain threshholds, 
great prizes will be sent to your in-game mailbox!
First purchases during the campaign period will grant additional bonus items!

During the event period, we will distribute the following wonderful items
to new accounts and accounts that have not logged in for some time!
A thank you campaign will be held at the same time!

now is the time to soak up the sun and split watermelons!

Let's search for Nobunaga who's in disguise!

The first part of the event quest involves water melon splitting,
and the second is a test of courage!
Hideyoshi will provide a treasure chest Nyankoropon,
and Katsuie provides an exchange int he second half.

NPC [???] in Kaga.

for additional summoning scrolls!

luxurious items from Hideyoshi's exchange!

Players can also receive either Six or Ninety-Nine as part of the main story!

[h3]Concerning Toshiie and Inuchiyo[/h3]
A new Style System feature will be added.
By holding down the weapon switch key during vanguard swap,
you can transform into Inuchiyo.
Moreover, Toshiie and Inuchiyo also have a gauge system!
Attacking as Toshiie will fill the gauge, allowing Inuchiyo to use the gauge to fight!
※As the gauge rises, lightning attribute will also increase.
　When the gauge reaches 0 the lightning and slash attributes will decrease.
To obtain Inuchiyo, you will need the Summoner's Scroll -  Maeda Toshiie to raise the Awakening Level.


[h2]・New Nyankoropon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/15559c820b30acceefcb29104f4d513721661e07.jpg[/img]

The new characters [b]Maeda Toshiie,[/b]

will be available in the new Nyankoropon!

Check all of the details below.
https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/info/topic/update/65673/web


[h2]・Main Story Updated！[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/2c852d09801fb8c08e03b2fff564657d6d77ca99.jpg[/img]

[b]Synopsis[/b]
Having saved the magic floating city of Kyoto from the fate of being brought crashing down, our heroes are enjoying a short respite. Amaterasu has not even left the bounds of the city when Benkei intercepts a strangely familiar signal.

Following the dim signal to its source they discover a female android in a wretched shape. Something about this young girl's features stir a distant memory in Kaguya.

A mechanical maiden's fall from the moon? That could only mean...


New Main Story added!
Playing through the main story events will give players access to the
new characters [b]Six and Ninety-Nine's Summoning Scroll[/b] as a part of the story!

It seems that Houou has come to greet Amaterasu on this lovely new year’s day!

However, Raijin has some worrisome news to deliver?

Apparently it has to do with Yog-Sothoth… or does it?


This quest can be accepted from the NPC [Houou] in Onigashima.
In order to participate in this quest, you will need to clear the main quest up to Kaga.

[h3]■Event Dungeon[/h3]
Advance the story until Kaga and accept the quest from the NPC [???] to challenge the event dungeons.
Event items can be obtained by clearing the dungeons.

Exchange the event items [Bizzare Tentacle] and [Bizzare Wing] for wonderful prizes!
Also, the NPC [Gawain] will have a Treasure Chest Nyankoropon.
Players can obtain many rare materials, so be certain to check it out!

　depleted with various actions.
　Furthermore, [b]your movement speed is increased while riding the mount[/b].

　Don't miss this opportunity to catch some bugs and trade them in for amazing prizes.

notes.title: 7/2 - 7/3 Maintenance Update Contents
notes.content:
This is the Onigiri Management Team,

The update contents from the 7/2 - 7/3 maintenance are as follows.

[h1][b]Update Contents:[/b][/h1]
　・The following will have their duration periods extended.
　　The Valentine's Day event
　　The Mysterious Girl in Onigashima event
　　The Dungeon Boost Campaign
　　The Regular Nyankoropon
　　The Limited Nyankoropon
　　The Limited Discount Nyankoropon
　　The Premium Nyankoropon

　[b]◆End Date[/b]
　　Extended until the maintenance of 7/28


[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
　・The issue wherein executing certain skills would cause clients to crash will be fixed.
　・The rendering issue in Sekigahara will be fixed.
　・The issue wherein touching certain objects causes the game to freeze (e.g. the shutters in the dungeon "Gennai Inn") will be fixed.

　Furthermore, as compensation for the bugs described above we will be sending a present to all users registered before 7/2 10pm PDT.

　[b]■Compensation Present Contents[/b]
　　・50 OC (Free)
　　・Gacha Ticket x 5
　　・Login Boost Ticket x5
　　・Full Restorative x10
　　・All Boost +200% (60 min) x5

*You can accept the present via going to the "Menu", and clicking on "System", and selecting "Presents".
*This present can only be accepted on one character per account, so please be careful when accepting it as once it is accepted it cannot be accepted on other characters.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this issue and we thank you for your kind patience.

We hope to see you in-game soon!
